name: Amoxicillin (أموكسيسيلين)
uses: Bacterial infections: ear infections, pneumonia, bronchitis, UTI, skin infections, H. pylori. يستخدم لعلاج التهابات الأذن والرئة والجهاز البولي.
dosage: Adults: 250-500mg every 8 hours or 500-875mg every 12 hours. Children: 25-45mg/kg/day divided every 8-12 hours.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, skin rash, allergic reactions (hives, anaphylaxis). الغثيان، الإسهال، الطفح الجلدي، الحساسية الشديدة.
contraindications: Penicillin allergy. Caution in kidney disease. حساسية البنسلين.
interactions: Warfarin (increased bleeding risk), Methotrexate (toxicity), oral contraceptives (reduced effectiveness).

name: Azithromycin (أزيثروميسين / زيثروماكس)
uses: Respiratory infections, chlamydia, community-acquired pneumonia, skin infections, ear infections. التهابات الجهاز التنفسي، الالتهاب الرئوي.
dosage: Adults: 500mg day 1, then 250mg days 2-5. Or 500mg once daily for 3 days.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, abdominal pain, QT prolongation (cardiac risk). ألم بطني، تأثير على القلب.
contraindications: Macrolide allergy, QT prolongation history, severe liver disease.
interactions: Antacids (reduce absorption), Warfarin, Digoxin, Statins.

name: Ciprofloxacin (سيبروفلوكساسين)
uses: UTI, respiratory infections, bone infections, anthrax, typhoid. التهابات المسالك البولية، عدوى السالمونيلا.
dosage: Adults: 250-750mg every 12 hours. UTI: 250mg twice daily for 3-7 days.
side_effects: Tendon rupture risk, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, photosensitivity. تمزق الأوتار، دوخة، حساسية للضوء.
contraindications: Children under 18 (generally), pregnancy, fluoroquinolone allergy, myasthenia gravis.
interactions: Antacids/dairy (reduce absorption), Warfarin, NSAIDs, Theophylline.

name: Metronidazole (ميترونيدازول / فلاجيل)
uses: Bacterial vaginosis, C. diff, H. pylori (with other drugs), parasitic infections (Giardia, Trichomoniasis), dental abscesses. التهابات اللثة والأسنان، الجيارديا.
dosage: Adults: 400-500mg 2-3 times daily for 5-10 days. H. pylori: 500mg twice daily (triple therapy).
side_effects: Metallic taste, nausea, dark urine, peripheral neuropathy (long use). طعم معدني، بول داكن، تنميل.
contraindications: First trimester pregnancy, alcohol use (disulfiram-like reaction). تجنب الكحول تماماً.
interactions: ALCOHOL (severe reaction), Warfarin, Lithium, Phenytoin.

name: Paracetamol / Acetaminophen (باراسيتامول)
uses: Pain relief, fever reduction. Headache, dental pain, muscle aches. تسكين الألم وخفض الحرارة. مناسب للأطفال والحوامل.
dosage: Adults: 500-1000mg every 4-6 hours. Max 4000mg/day. Children: 10-15mg/kg every 4-6 hours.
side_effects: Generally well-tolerated. Liver damage with overdose. تلف الكبد عند الجرعة الزائدة.
contraindications: Severe liver disease. Alcohol use increases liver risk.
interactions: Warfarin (small increase in INR), Alcohol (liver toxicity), Rifampicin (reduces effect).
pregnancy_safety: Category B - Preferred analgesic in pregnancy

name: Ibuprofen (إيبوبروفين / بروفين)
uses: Pain, fever, inflammation. Arthritis, dysmenorrhea, headache, dental pain. الألم، الحمى، التهابات المفاصل، آلام الدورة.
dosage: Adults: 200-400mg every 4-6 hours. Max 1200mg/day OTC, 3200mg prescription. Take with food.
side_effects: GI upset, stomach ulcers, kidney damage (long use), increased BP, fluid retention. قرحة المعدة، تأثير على الكلى.
contraindications: Active GI bleeding, severe kidney/liver disease, third trimester pregnancy, aspirin allergy.
interactions: Aspirin (reduced cardioprotection), Warfarin (bleeding), ACE inhibitors (kidney risk), Lithium.
alternatives: Paracetamol (safer GI profile), Naproxen, Diclofenac, Celecoxib

name: Diclofenac (ديكلوفيناك / فولتارين)
uses: Arthritis, acute pain, dysmenorrhea, migraines, gout. التهاب المفاصل، النقرس، آلام الدورة الشهرية.
dosage: Adults: 50mg 2-3 times daily, or 75mg twice daily (slow release). Apply gel locally for joint pain.
side_effects: GI bleeding, liver enzyme elevation, cardiovascular risk, edema. نزيف معدي، تأثير على الكبد.
contraindications: GI ulcers, severe heart/kidney/liver failure, aspirin allergy.
interactions: Warfarin, Lithium, Cyclosporine, ACE inhibitors, other NSAIDs.

name: Amlodipine (أملوديبين / نورفاسك)
uses: High blood pressure, angina, coronary artery disease. ضغط الدم المرتفع، الذبحة الصدرية.
dosage: Adults: 5mg once daily. May increase to 10mg. Take at same time each day.
side_effects: Peripheral edema (ankle swelling), flushing, headache, dizziness, palpitations. تورم الكاحلين، احمرار الوجه.
contraindications: Severe hypotension, cardiogenic shock, aortic stenosis.
interactions: Simvastatin (limit to 20mg/day), Cyclosporine, Tacrolimus, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Atorvastatin (أتورفاستاتين / ليبيتور)
uses: High cholesterol, cardiovascular disease prevention, stroke prevention. ارتفاع الكوليسترول، الوقاية من أمراض القلب.
dosage: Adults: 10-80mg once daily. Usually taken in the evening.
side_effects: Muscle pain/weakness (myopathy), liver enzyme elevation, rarely rhabdomyolysis. ألم عضلي، تأثير على الكبد.
contraindications: Active liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, unexplained elevated liver enzymes.
interactions: Fibrates (muscle toxicity), Niacin, Amlodipine, Diltiazem, Grapefruit juice.

name: Metoprolol (ميتوبرولول / لوبريسور)
uses: High blood pressure, heart failure, angina, arrhythmias, post-MI. ضغط الدم، قصور القلب، الذبحة.
dosage: Hypertension: 25-100mg twice daily. Heart failure: start 12.5-25mg daily.
side_effects: Bradycardia, fatigue, dizziness, cold extremities, depression, mask hypoglycemia symptoms. بطء القلب، تعب، برودة الأطراف.
contraindications: Severe bradycardia, heart block, decompensated heart failure, bronchospasm/asthma.
interactions: Calcium channel blockers (cardiac depression), Digoxin, Clonidine, MAOIs.

name: Warfarin (وارفارين / كومادين)
uses: DVT, pulmonary embolism, atrial fibrillation, mechanical heart valves, stroke prevention. منع تجلط الدم، الفلوتر الأذيني.
dosage: Highly individualized. Typical: 2-10mg daily. Guided by INR (target 2-3 usually).
side_effects: Bleeding (major risk), bruising, hemorrhage. نزيف هو الخطر الرئيسي.
contraindications: Pregnancy, active bleeding, severe hypertension, recent surgery.
interactions: MANY DRUGS INTERACT: Aspirin, NSAIDs, Antibiotics, Antifungals, Amiodarone, Statins. Also food: Vitamin K-rich foods (spinach, broccoli).
alternatives: Rivaroxaban, Apixaban, Dabigatran (DOACs - less monitoring needed)

name: Aspirin (أسبرين)
uses: Pain, fever (low dose), cardiovascular event prevention, antiplatelet therapy. الوقاية من النوبات القلبية والسكتات الدماغية.
dosage: Pain/fever: 325-650mg every 4-6 hours. Antiplatelet: 75-100mg once daily.
side_effects: GI bleeding, stomach ulcers, Reye's syndrome (children), tinnitus (high dose). نزيف معدي.
contraindications: Children with viral illness (Reye's), active GI bleeding, severe kidney/liver disease.
interactions: Warfarin (bleeding), other NSAIDs, Methotrexate, ACE inhibitors.
pregnancy_safety: Category D - Avoid, especially third trimester

name: Metformin (ميتفورمين / جلوكوفاج)
uses: Type 2 diabetes (first-line), PCOS. يستخدم كعلاج أول لمرض السكري النوع الثاني.
dosage: Start 500mg twice daily with meals. Max 2550mg/day. Increase slowly to reduce GI side effects.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset (improve with time), rare lactic acidosis. إسهال وغثيان في البداية.
contraindications: eGFR <30, iodinated contrast (hold 48h), acute heart failure, liver failure.
interactions: Contrast dye (hold before imaging), Alcohol (lactic acidosis risk), Cimetidine.
pregnancy_safety: Category B - Often used in gestational diabetes

name: Glibenclamide / Glyburide (جليبنكلاميد)
uses: Type 2 diabetes. يحفز البنكرياس على إفراز الأنسولين.
dosage: Adults: 2.5-5mg once daily with breakfast. Max 20mg/day.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (main risk), weight gain, nausea. هبوط السكر هو الخطر الرئيسي.
contraindications: Type 1 diabetes, DKA, severe kidney/liver disease, pregnancy.
interactions: Fluconazole (hypoglycemia), NSAIDs, Alcohol, Beta-blockers (mask hypoglycemia).

name: Salbutamol / Albuterol (سالبوتامول / فنتولين)
uses: Asthma attacks (rescue inhaler), COPD, bronchospasm. الربو، موسع للشعب الهوائية عند الأزمات.
dosage: Inhaler: 1-2 puffs (100mcg each) every 4-6 hours as needed. Nebulization: 2.5mg every 4-8 hours.
side_effects: Tremor, tachycardia, headache, hypokalemia (high doses). رعشة، سرعة نبضات القلب.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to salbutamol.
interactions: Beta-blockers (oppose effect), MAOIs, tricyclic antidepressants.

name: Montelukast (مونتيلوكاست / سينجولار)
uses: Asthma prevention, allergic rhinitis, exercise-induced bronchospasm. الوقاية من الربو والحساسية الموسمية.
dosage: Adults: 10mg once daily in the evening. Children 6-14: 5mg. Children 2-5: 4mg.
side_effects: Headache, abdominal pain, neuropsychiatric effects (mood changes, suicidal thoughts - rare). تغيرات في المزاج.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Not for acute asthma attacks.
interactions: Rifampicin, Phenobarbital (reduce levels), Gemfibrozil.

name: Omeprazole (أوميبرازول / لوسيك)
uses: GERD, peptic ulcer, H. pylori (with antibiotics), Zollinger-Ellison. حموضة المعدة، القرحة، ارتجاع المريء.
dosage: GERD: 20mg once daily before meals. Ulcer: 40mg once daily. H. pylori: 20mg twice daily + antibiotics.
side_effects: Headache, nausea, B12/magnesium deficiency (long use), C. diff risk, bone fracture (long use). نقص فيتامين B12 مع الاستخدام الطويل.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Use caution with long-term use.
interactions: Clopidogrel (reduced antiplatelet effect), Methotrexate, Atazanavir.

name: Ondansetron (أوندانسيترون / زوفران)
uses: Nausea and vomiting (chemotherapy, surgery, pregnancy). الغثيان والتقيؤ، دوار الحمل.
dosage: Adults: 4-8mg every 8-12 hours. IV: 4mg over 2-5 minutes.
side_effects: Headache, constipation, QT prolongation, serotonin syndrome (rare). إمساك، تأثير على القلب.
contraindications: Congenital long QT syndrome, use with apomorphine.
interactions: Apomorphine (contraindicated), Serotonergic drugs, Tramadol, SSRIs.

name: Metoclopramide (ميتوكلوبراميد / بريميران)
uses: Nausea, vomiting, gastroparesis, GERD. الغثيان، ضعف حركة المعدة.
dosage: Adults: 10mg up to 3 times daily, 30 minutes before meals. Max 5 days.
side_effects: Drowsiness, tardive dyskinesia (long use), extrapyramidal effects, restlessness. نعاس، حركات لا إرادية مع الاستخدام الطويل.
contraindications: GI obstruction, Parkinson's disease, phaeochromocytoma, tardive dyskinesia history.
interactions: MAOIs, Opioids, Anticholinergics, CNS depressants.

name: Sertraline (سيرترالين / زولوفت)
uses: Depression, OCD, panic disorder, PTSD, social anxiety, PMDD. الاكتئاب، القلق، الوسواس.
dosage: Start 50mg once daily. May increase to 200mg/day. Take consistently with or without food.
side_effects: Nausea, insomnia, sexual dysfunction, diarrhea, serotonin syndrome (with other drugs). خلل جنسي، أرق.
contraindications: MAOIs (within 14 days), Pimozide. Caution in bipolar without mood stabilizer.
interactions: MAOIs (serotonin syndrome), Tramadol, Linezolid, Pimozide, Warfarin.
pregnancy_safety: Category C - Discuss benefits vs risks

name: Alprazolam (ألبرازولام / زاناكس)
uses: Anxiety disorders, panic disorder. القلق، نوبات الهلع.
dosage: Anxiety: 0.25-0.5mg 3 times daily. Panic: 0.5-1mg 3 times daily. Short-term use only.
side_effects: Sedation, dependence/addiction, memory impairment, respiratory depression. إدمان، نعاس، ضعف الذاكرة.
contraindications: Severe respiratory insufficiency, sleep apnea, acute narrow-angle glaucoma, myasthenia gravis. مدمني الكحول.
interactions: CNS depressants, Alcohol (severe - risk of death), Opioids, Antifungals (increase levels).

name: Pregabalin (بريجابالين / ليريكا)
uses: Neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, epilepsy, generalized anxiety disorder. ألم الأعصاب، الفيبروميالجيا، القلق.
dosage: Neuropathic pain: 75-150mg twice daily. Max 600mg/day. Reduce dose in kidney disease.
side_effects: Dizziness, somnolence, weight gain, edema, blurred vision, dependence risk. دوخة، نعاس، زيادة الوزن.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Caution in heart failure, substance abuse history.
interactions: CNS depressants, Opioids (respiratory depression), Thiazolidinediones (edema).

name: Cetirizine (سيتيريزين / زيرتك)
uses: Allergic rhinitis, urticaria, hay fever, itching. حساسية الأنف، الشرى، الحكة.
dosage: Adults: 10mg once daily. Children 6-12: 5-10mg. Children 2-6: 2.5-5mg.
side_effects: Drowsiness (less than 1st gen), dry mouth, headache. نعاس خفيف، جفاف الفم.
contraindications: Severe kidney disease (reduce dose), hypersensitivity to hydroxyzine.
interactions: CNS depressants, Alcohol (increased sedation), Theophylline (slight increase in levels).

name: Loratadine (لوراتادين / كلاريتين)
uses: Allergic rhinitis, urticaria. Less sedating than older antihistamines. حساسية الأنف والعينين.
dosage: Adults and children >12: 10mg once daily. Children 2-12 (<30kg): 5mg daily.
side_effects: Headache, dry mouth, very rarely sedation. آمن جداً، نادراً ما يسبب نعاساً.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Reduce dose in liver disease.
interactions: Azithromycin, Cimetidine, Ketoconazole (increase levels slightly).

name: Hydrocortisone (هيدروكورتيزون)
uses: Inflammation, allergic reactions, adrenal insufficiency, skin conditions. التهابات الجلد، الحساسية، قصور الغدة الكظرية.
dosage: Topical: apply thin layer 2-4 times daily. IV (emergency): 100-500mg. Oral: 20-40mg/day.
side_effects: Skin thinning (topical), weight gain, osteoporosis, hyperglycemia, immunosuppression (systemic). ترقق الجلد، زيادة الوزن، السكر.
contraindications: Active infections (systemic use), live vaccines during therapy.
interactions: NSAIDs (GI bleeding), Warfarin, Rifampicin (reduced effect), vaccines (avoid live).

name: Levothyroxine (ليفوثيروكسين / إيلتروكسين)
uses: Hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid), goiter, thyroid cancer (after surgery). قصور الغدة الدرقية.
dosage: Start 25-50mcg once daily on empty stomach (30-60 min before breakfast). Adjust by TSH.
side_effects: If overdosed: tachycardia, palpitations, insomnia, tremor, weight loss. At correct dose: minimal. تسرع القلب عند الجرعة العالية.
contraindications: Thyrotoxicosis, uncorrected adrenal insufficiency.
interactions: Calcium/antacids/iron (reduce absorption - take 4h apart), Warfarin, Digoxin.
pregnancy_safety: Category A - Safe and often required

name: Timolol Eye Drops (تيمولول قطرة عين)
uses: Glaucoma (elevated eye pressure), ocular hypertension. الجلوكوما، ارتفاع ضغط العين.
dosage: 1 drop in affected eye(s) twice daily (0.25% or 0.5%).
side_effects: Local: burning, stinging. Systemic (absorbed): bradycardia, bronchospasm. تأثير على القلب والتنفس عبر الامتصاص.
contraindications: Asthma, COPD, heart block, bradycardia, heart failure.
interactions: Systemic beta-blockers, Calcium channel blockers, Digoxin.

name: Vitamin D3 (فيتامين D3 / كوليكالسيفيرول)
uses: Vitamin D deficiency, bone health (with calcium), immune support, rickets prevention. نقص فيتامين د، صحة العظام.
dosage: Deficiency treatment: 50,000 IU weekly for 8 weeks then maintenance 1500-2000 IU/day.
side_effects: Toxicity (very high doses): hypercalcemia, nausea, weakness, kidney stones. السمية عند الجرعات العالية جداً.
contraindications: Hypercalcemia, vitamin D toxicity, sarcoidosis, certain lymphomas.
interactions: Thiazide diuretics (hypercalcemia), Digoxin (toxicity with hypercalcemia).

name: Iron / Ferrous Sulfate (كبريتات الحديدوز / حديد)
uses: Iron-deficiency anemia, pregnancy supplementation. فقر الدم الناتج عن نقص الحديد.
dosage: Adults: 200mg (65mg elemental) 2-3 times daily on empty stomach. With vitamin C enhances absorption.
side_effects: Constipation, dark stools, nausea, stomach pain. إمساك، براز داكن.
contraindications: Hemochromatosis, hemolytic anemia, repeated blood transfusions.
interactions: Antacids (reduce absorption), Tetracyclines, Fluoroquinolones, Levothyroxine (take 4h apart).
alternatives: Ferrous gluconate, Ferrous fumarate, IV iron (Ferinject)

name: Clotrimazole (كلوتريمازول / كانستن)
uses: Fungal skin infections: athlete's foot, ringworm, thrush (candidiasis), jock itch. فطريات الجلد، المهبل، الفم.
dosage: Topical: apply thin layer 2-3 times daily for 2-4 weeks. Vaginal: 100mg/500mg pessary.
side_effects: Local irritation, burning, redness. تهيج موضعي.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to imidazoles.
interactions: Minimal systemic interactions (topical use).
pregnancy_safety: Category B (topical) - Preferred antifungal in pregnancy

name: Fluconazole (فلوكونازول / ديفلوكان)
uses: Candidiasis (vaginal, oral, systemic), cryptococcal meningitis, tinea infections. فطريات الفم والمهبل والدم.
dosage: Vaginal candidiasis: single 150mg dose. Oral thrush: 50-100mg daily for 7-14 days.
side_effects: Nausea, headache, rash, liver toxicity (rare), QT prolongation. تأثير على الكبد.
contraindications: QT prolongation, severe liver disease. Avoid with many QT-prolonging drugs.
interactions: Warfarin (major - increased bleeding), Cisapride, Pimozide, Rifampicin, many statins.
pregnancy_safety: Category C/D - Avoid in first trimester

name: Amlodipine (أملوديبين / نورفاسك)
uses: Hypertension, angina. ارتفاع ضغط الدم والذبحة الصدرية.
dosage: 5-10mg once daily
side_effects: Ankle swelling, flushing, headache, palpitations. تورم الكاحل، صداع.
contraindications: Severe aortic stenosis, cardiogenic shock.
interactions: Simvastatin (increase dose limit), CYP3A4 inhibitors, Cyclosporine.

name: Lisinopril (ليسينوبريل)
uses: Hypertension, heart failure, post-MI, diabetic nephropathy. ضغط الدم وقصور القلب.
dosage: 5-40mg once daily
side_effects: Dry cough (10-20%), hypotension, hyperkalemia, angioedema. سعال جاف، انخفاض الضغط.
contraindications: Pregnancy (teratogenic), angioedema history, bilateral renal artery stenosis.
interactions: NSAIDs (reduce effect), Potassium-sparing diuretics, Lithium.

name: Losartan (لوسارتان)
uses: Hypertension, heart failure, diabetic nephropathy, stroke prevention. ضغط الدم وحماية الكلى.
dosage: 25-100mg once or twice daily
side_effects: Dizziness, hyperkalemia, renal impairment. دوخة، ارتفاع البوتاسيوم.
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis.
interactions: NSAIDs, ACE inhibitors (avoid dual blockade), Potassium supplements.

name: Enalapril (إنالابريل)
uses: Hypertension, heart failure, left ventricular dysfunction. قصور القلب وارتفاع الضغط.
dosage: 5-40mg once or twice daily
side_effects: Dry cough, hypotension, hyperkalemia, angioedema.
contraindications: Pregnancy, angioedema history.
interactions: NSAIDs, Potassium-sparing diuretics, Lithium.

name: Ramipril (راميبريل)
uses: Hypertension, post-MI cardioprotection, diabetic nephropathy. حماية القلب بعد النوبة.
dosage: 1.25-10mg once daily
side_effects: Dry cough, hypotension, angioedema, hyperkalemia.
contraindications: Pregnancy, angioedema, bilateral renal artery stenosis.
interactions: NSAIDs, Potassium-sparing diuretics, Aliskiren.

name: Valsartan (فالسارتان)
uses: Hypertension, heart failure, post-MI. ضغط الدم وقصور القلب.
dosage: 80-320mg once daily
side_effects: Dizziness, hyperkalemia, renal impairment.
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis.
interactions: NSAIDs, ACE inhibitors, Potassium supplements.

name: Bisoprolol (بيسوبرولول)
uses: Hypertension, heart failure, angina, atrial fibrillation. قصور القلب، الرجفان الأذيني.
dosage: 2.5-10mg once daily
side_effects: Bradycardia, fatigue, cold extremities, bronchospasm (caution in asthma).
contraindications: Severe bradycardia, heart block, decompensated heart failure, severe asthma.
interactions: Diltiazem/Verapamil (bradycardia), Clonidine, other antihypertensives.

name: Carvedilol (كارفيديلول)
uses: Heart failure, hypertension, post-MI. قصور القلب الانقباضي.
dosage: 3.125-50mg twice daily (titrate slowly)
side_effects: Hypotension, dizziness, bradycardia, fatigue, weight gain.
contraindications: Severe bradycardia, cardiogenic shock, severe asthma.
interactions: Digoxin, Insulin (mask hypoglycemia), Diltiazem.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide - HCTZ (هيدروكلوروثيازيد)
uses: Hypertension, edema, heart failure. ارتفاع ضغط الدم والوذمة.
dosage: 12.5-50mg once daily
side_effects: Hypokalemia, hyponatremia, hyperuricemia, hyperglycemia. نقص البوتاسيوم.
contraindications: Anuria, sulfonamide allergy.
interactions: NSAIDs (reduce effect), Lithium (toxicity), Digoxin (hypokalemia increases toxicity).

name: Furosemide (فيوروسيميد / لاسيكس)
uses: Heart failure, pulmonary edema, hypertension, nephrotic syndrome. وذمة القلب والرئة.
dosage: 20-80mg once or twice daily. IV: 20-40mg over 2 min.
side_effects: Dehydration, hypokalemia, hyponatremia, ototoxicity (high doses). نقص الصوديوم والبوتاسيوم.
contraindications: Anuria, sulfonamide allergy, severe hypovolemia.
interactions: Aminoglycosides (nephro/ototoxicity), Lithium, NSAIDs, Digoxin.

name: Spironolactone (سبيرونولاكتون / ألداكتون)
uses: Heart failure, hypertension, primary hyperaldosteronism, acne (off-label). قصور القلب وفرط الألدوستيرون.
dosage: 25-100mg once or twice daily
side_effects: Hyperkalemia, gynecomastia, menstrual irregularities, breast tenderness. ارتفاع البوتاسيوم، تثدي.
contraindications: Hyperkalemia, Addison's disease, severe renal impairment.
interactions: ACE inhibitors/ARBs (severe hyperkalemia), NSAIDs, Digoxin.

name: Amlodipine + Valsartan (Exforge)
uses: Hypertension not controlled on monotherapy. ضغط الدم غير المسيطر عليه بدواء واحد.
dosage: 5/160mg to 10/320mg once daily
side_effects: Edema, dizziness, headache, hyperkalemia.
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal stenosis.
interactions: NSAIDs, Potassium supplements.

name: Nifedipine (نيفيديبين / أدالات)
uses: Hypertension, angina, Raynaud's phenomenon, preterm labor. الذبحة الصدرية وارتفاع الضغط.
dosage: 30-90mg SR once daily; 10-20mg immediate-release TID
side_effects: Flushing, headache, palpitations, ankle edema, reflex tachycardia.
contraindications: Cardiogenic shock, acute MI, unstable angina (immediate-release).
interactions: CYP3A4 inhibitors (increase levels), Rifampicin, Digoxin.

name: Diltiazem (ديلتيازيم)
uses: Angina, hypertension, atrial fibrillation, SVT. الذبحة الصدرية والرجفان الأذيني.
dosage: 120-360mg/day in divided doses or SR formulation
side_effects: Bradycardia, hypotension, edema, AV block, constipation.
contraindications: Severe bradycardia, heart block (>1st degree), WPW syndrome, LVEF<40%.
interactions: Beta-blockers (bradycardia), Digoxin, Simvastatin, Cyclosporine.

name: Isosorbide Mononitrate (إيزوسوربيد أحادي النترات)
uses: Angina prophylaxis, heart failure. الوقاية من الذبحة الصدرية.
dosage: 20-120mg daily (eccentric dosing to avoid tolerance)
side_effects: Headache (common), hypotension, flushing, dizziness. صداع قوي.
contraindications: Phosphodiesterase inhibitors (sildenafil - severe hypotension), hypotension.
interactions: Sildenafil/Tadalafil (FATAL hypotension), Antihypertensives, Alcohol.

name: Digoxin (ديجوكسين / لانوكسين)
uses: Atrial fibrillation rate control, heart failure (narrow TI). الرجفان الأذيني وقصور القلب.
dosage: 0.125-0.25mg once daily (narrow therapeutic index!)
side_effects: Nausea, visual disturbances (yellow halos), bradycardia, arrhythmias. رؤية صفراء، بطء القلب.
contraindications: Ventricular fibrillation, WPW syndrome, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
interactions: Amiodarone (double levels), Verapamil, Quinidine, Clarithromycin, Hypokalemia.
alternatives: Beta-blockers or diltiazem for rate control

name: Amiodarone (أميودارون / كوردارون)
uses: Ventricular arrhythmias, atrial fibrillation. اضطرابات نظم القلب الخطيرة.
dosage: Loading: 800-1600mg/day × 1-3 weeks. Maintenance: 200-400mg/day
side_effects: Pulmonary toxicity, thyroid dysfunction (hypo/hyper), liver toxicity, corneal deposits, photosensitivity, blue-gray skin.
contraindications: Iodine allergy, thyroid disease (relative), severe bradycardia, SA/AV block.
interactions: Warfarin (major - double INR), Digoxin (toxicity), Simvastatin, QT-prolonging drugs.

name: Aspirin Low-dose (أسبرين منخفض الجرعة - كارديو)
uses: Cardiovascular event prevention (secondary), acute MI treatment. الوقاية من النوبات القلبية.
dosage: 75-100mg once daily (antiplatelet); 300-325mg for acute MI
side_effects: GI bleeding, peptic ulcer, Reye's syndrome (children), bronchoconstriction.
contraindications: Aspirin allergy, active GI bleeding, children with viral illness (Reye's).
interactions: Warfarin, Clopidogrel, NSAIDs, SSRIs (increase bleeding).

name: Clopidogrel (كلوبيدوغريل / بلافيكس)
uses: ACS, post-stent placement, peripheral artery disease. بعد وضع الدعامة وعمليات القلب.
dosage: 75mg once daily (loading dose 300-600mg)
side_effects: Bleeding, bruising, TTP (rare). نزيف، كدمات.
contraindications: Active pathological bleeding, severe hepatic impairment.
interactions: PPIs (omeprazole reduces effect), Aspirin (dual therapy), SSRIs.

name: Atorvastatin (أتورفاستاتين / ليبيتور)
uses: High cholesterol, cardiovascular risk reduction, primary/secondary prevention. خفض الكوليسترول.
dosage: 10-80mg once daily (evening)
side_effects: Myopathy/rhabdomyolysis (rare), elevated liver enzymes, headache, GI upset. ألم العضلات.
contraindications: Active liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding.
interactions: Gemfibrozil (myopathy risk), Clarithromycin, Cyclosporine, CYP3A4 inhibitors, Warfarin.

name: Rosuvastatin (روسوفاستاتين / كريستور)
uses: Hypercholesterolemia, primary prevention in high-risk patients. كوليسترول مرتفع.
dosage: 5-40mg once daily
side_effects: Myopathy, elevated liver enzymes, headache, proteinuria (high doses).
contraindications: Liver disease, pregnancy, severe renal impairment (>40mg).
interactions: Cyclosporine (max 5mg), Gemfibrozil, Antacids.

name: Simvastatin (سيمفاستاتين / زوكور)
uses: Hypercholesterolemia, cardiovascular risk reduction. تخفيض الكوليسترول والوقاية القلبية.
dosage: 10-40mg once daily (evening). Max 80mg (avoid - myopathy risk)
side_effects: Myopathy (dose-dependent), elevated LFTs, headache, GI.
contraindications: Liver disease, pregnancy, concurrent strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.
interactions: Amlodipine (max 20mg simva), Amiodarone, Diltiazem, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Warfarin (وارفارين / كومادين)
uses: DVT/PE treatment, AF stroke prevention, mechanical heart valves. الجلطات والرجفان الأذيني.
dosage: Individualized by INR (target 2-3 usually). Typical 2-10mg/day
side_effects: Bleeding (major risk), skin necrosis (rare), purple toe syndrome. نزيف.
contraindications: Active bleeding, pregnancy, recent surgery (relative), falls risk.
interactions: HUNDREDS of interactions. Major: Aspirin, NSAIDs, Amiodarone, Antibiotics, Vitamins K-rich foods, Alcohol.

name: Apixaban (أبيكسابان / إليكيس)
uses: AF stroke prevention, DVT/PE treatment and prevention. الوقاية من الجلطات.
dosage: AF: 5mg twice daily (2.5mg if criteria met). DVT/PE treatment: 10mg BID × 7 days then 5mg BID
side_effects: Bleeding, anemia, bruising. Less intracranial bleeding vs warfarin.
contraindications: Active significant bleeding, severe hepatic impairment, mechanical valves.
interactions: P-gp and CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, ketoconazole increase levels).

name: Metformin (ميتفورمين / جلوكوفاج)
uses: Type 2 diabetes (first-line), PCOS, prediabetes prevention. أول دواء لمرض السكر.
dosage: 500mg twice daily initially, increase to 1000mg twice daily. Max 2550mg/day
side_effects: GI: nausea, diarrhea, abdominal cramps (take with food). Lactic acidosis (rare, esp. renal failure). غثيان وإسهال.
contraindications: eGFR<30, heart failure (relative), liver failure, contrast media (hold 48h), alcoholism.
interactions: Alcohol (lactic acidosis), Cimetidine, Contrast dye, Iodinated contrast.

name: Glibenclamide / Glyburide (جليبنكلاميد / دياويل)
uses: Type 2 diabetes (stimulates insulin secretion). السكر من النوع الثاني.
dosage: 2.5-15mg once or twice daily with meals
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (main risk), weight gain, nausea. نقص سكر الدم.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, DKA, severe renal/hepatic failure, pregnancy (use insulin).
interactions: Alcohol (hypoglycemia), NSAIDs, Warfarin, Beta-blockers (mask hypoglycemia signs).

name: Gliclazide (جليكلازيد / ديامكرون)
uses: Type 2 diabetes. Lower hypoglycemia risk vs glibenclamide. السكر من النوع الثاني.
dosage: 40-320mg/day; MR formulation: 30-120mg once daily
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (lower risk than other sulfonylureas), weight gain, GI.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, DKA, severe renal/hepatic failure.
interactions: Alcohol, NSAIDs, Warfarin, Beta-blockers.

name: Sitagliptin (سيتاجليبتين / جانوفيا)
uses: Type 2 diabetes (as add-on or monotherapy). لا يسبب نقص سكر. مناسب للكلى.
dosage: 100mg once daily (adjust in renal impairment)
side_effects: Nasopharyngitis, headache, pancreatitis (rare), joint pain.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, DKA, previous pancreatitis.
interactions: Digoxin (slightly increases levels), Cyclosporine.

name: Empagliflozin (إمباجليفلوزين / جارديانس)
uses: Type 2 DM, heart failure with reduced EF, CKD. حماية القلب والكلى في مرض السكر.
dosage: 10-25mg once daily
side_effects: UTI, genital mycotic infections, DKA (rare), Fournier's gangrene (rare), polyuria.
contraindications: eGFR<30, Type 1 DM, DKA.
interactions: Diuretics (dehydration), Insulin (reduce dose).

name: Dapagliflozin (داباجليفلوزين / فارشيجا)
uses: Type 2 DM, heart failure, CKD. السكر وقصور القلب وأمراض الكلى.
dosage: 10mg once daily
side_effects: UTI, genital infections, polyuria, hypotension, DKA (rare).
contraindications: eGFR<25, Type 1 DM.
interactions: Insulin, Diuretics, Rifampicin.

name: Insulin Regular (أنسولين عادي / أكترابيد)
uses: Type 1 DM, Type 2 DM, DKA, hyperkalemia. السكر من النوع الأول والحالات الطارئة.
dosage: Individualized. Pre-meal: 0.1-0.2 units/kg. IV for DKA: 0.1 units/kg/hour
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (main risk), weight gain, lipodystrophy at injection site. نقص سكر.
contraindications: Hypoglycemia.
interactions: Alcohol, Beta-blockers (mask signs), corticosteroids (increase need).
pregnancy_safety: Category B — Safe, preferred in pregnancy

name: Insulin Glargine (أنسولين جلارجين / لانتوس)
uses: Type 1 and Type 2 DM as basal insulin. الأنسولين الأساسي طويل المفعول.
dosage: Once daily subcutaneously, same time daily. Dose individualized.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia, weight gain, injection site reactions, lipodystrophy.
contraindications: Hypoglycemia.
interactions: Alcohol, corticosteroids, thiazides, beta-blockers.

name: Liraglutide (ليراجلوتيد / فيكتوزا)
uses: Type 2 DM, weight management (Saxenda brand), CV risk reduction. السكر وإنقاص الوزن.
dosage: 0.6mg SC daily × 1 week, then 1.2mg; max 1.8mg daily
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, pancreatitis (rare), thyroid C-cell tumors (animal data).
contraindications: Personal/family history of MTC, MEN2, pancreatitis.
interactions: Oral medications (delays gastric emptying), Insulin (reduce dose).

name: Salbutamol / Albuterol (سالبوتامول / فنتولين)
uses: Acute bronchospasm, asthma attack, COPD exacerbation, exercise-induced asthma. أزمة الربو.
dosage: Inhaler: 100-200mcg (1-2 puffs) every 4-6 hours PRN. Nebulizer: 2.5mg in 3mL NS.
side_effects: Tremor, palpitations, tachycardia, hypokalemia (high doses). رعشة، خفقان.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, uncorrected hypokalemia (high doses).
interactions: Beta-blockers (antagonize), MAOIs, TCAs, Theophylline.

name: Salmeterol (سالميترول / سيريفنت)
uses: Asthma maintenance (with ICS - never alone), COPD maintenance. صيانة الربو والانسداد الرئوي.
dosage: 50mcg twice daily via Accuhaler
side_effects: Palpitations, tremor, headache, paradoxical bronchospasm.
contraindications: Acute asthma attack, monotherapy in asthma (FDA black box).
interactions: Beta-blockers, MAOIs, TCAs, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Fluticasone Inhaled (فلوتيكازون / فليكساتيد)
uses: Asthma maintenance (reduces inflammation). لا يستخدم للأزمة الحادة. صيانة الربو.
dosage: 88-440mcg twice daily via MDI or dry powder
side_effects: Oral candidiasis, dysphonia, adrenal suppression (high doses). فطريات الفم.
contraindications: Acute asthma attack, hypersensitivity.
interactions: Ritonavir, Ketoconazole (increase systemic absorption).

name: Budesonide (بوديزونيد / بولميكورت)
uses: Asthma, COPD, Crohn's disease, allergic rhinitis. التهاب الأمعاء والربو.
dosage: Inhaler: 200-1600mcg/day. Crohn's: 9mg oral daily.
side_effects: Oral candidiasis, dysphonia, growth suppression in children.
contraindications: Active untreated pulmonary TB.
interactions: Itraconazole, Ritonavir (increase systemic levels).
pregnancy_safety: Category B (inhaled preferred ICS in pregnancy)

name: Montelukast (مونتيلوكاست / سينجولار)
uses: Asthma, allergic rhinitis, exercise-induced bronchoconstriction. الربو والحساسية الأنفية.
dosage: Adults: 10mg once daily (evening). Children 2-5y: 4mg; 6-14y: 5mg
side_effects: Headache, behavioral changes/depression/suicidality (FDA black box warning), abdominal pain.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Phenobarbital, Rifampicin (reduce levels), Gemfibrozil.

name: Ipratropium (إيبراتروبيوم / أتروفنت)
uses: COPD, asthma (add-on), acute bronchospasm. الانسداد الرئوي المزمن.
dosage: MDI: 20-40mcg (1-2 puffs) 3-4 times daily. Nebulizer: 0.5mg QID.
side_effects: Dry mouth, blurred vision (if eye exposure), urinary retention, constipation.
contraindications: Narrow-angle glaucoma (inhaled caution), benign prostatic hyperplasia.
interactions: Other anticholinergics.

name: Theophylline (ثيوفيلين / ثيودور)
uses: Asthma, COPD (third-line). ضيق التنفس والانسداد الرئوي المزمن.
dosage: SR: 200-400mg twice daily. Narrow therapeutic index - monitor levels.
side_effects: Nausea, tachycardia, headache, insomnia, seizures (toxic levels). أعراض تسمم خطيرة.
contraindications: Seizure disorders (caution), hyperthyroidism, peptic ulcer.
interactions: HUNDREDS. Major: Ciprofloxacin, Erythromycin, Cimetidine (increase), Rifampicin (decrease).

name: Cetirizine (سيتيريزين / زيرتك)
uses: Allergic rhinitis, urticaria, atopic dermatitis. حساسية الأنف والجلد.
dosage: 10mg once daily. Children 6-12y: 5-10mg/day
side_effects: Mild drowsiness (less than 1st gen), dry mouth, headache. نعاس خفيف.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to cetirizine or hydroxyzine.
interactions: CNS depressants (alcohol, sedatives), Theophylline.

name: Loratadine (لوراتادين / كلاريتين)
uses: Allergic rhinitis, chronic urticaria. Non-sedating. حساسية الأنف والشرى.
dosage: 10mg once daily. Children 2-5y: 5mg/day
side_effects: Minimal - headache, dry mouth (rarely sedating at standard doses).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Ketoconazole, Erythromycin (increase levels - clinical significance low).

name: Fexofenadine (فيكسوفينادين / أليجرا)
uses: Allergic rhinitis, chronic idiopathic urticaria. Non-sedating, no QT prolongation.
dosage: 120mg once daily or 180mg once daily
side_effects: Headache, nausea, dyspepsia. Least sedating antihistamine.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Antacids containing aluminum/magnesium (reduce absorption), Erythromycin.

name: Levocetirizine (ليفوسيتيريزين / زيزال)
uses: Allergic rhinitis, chronic urticaria. حساسية الأنف.
dosage: 5mg once daily (evening)
side_effects: Drowsiness, dry mouth, fatigue.
contraindications: Severe renal impairment, hypersensitivity.
interactions: CNS depressants.

name: Omeprazole (أوميبرازول / لوسيك)
uses: GERD, peptic ulcer, H. pylori (triple therapy), Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, NSAID gastroprotection. حموضة المعدة.
dosage: 20-40mg once daily before breakfast. H. pylori: 20-40mg twice daily (7-14 days).
side_effects: Headache, nausea, hypomagnesemia, C. diff risk, B12 deficiency (long-term). نقص المغنيسيوم.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, rilpivirine use.
interactions: Clopidogrel (reduce antiplatelet effect - use pantoprazole instead), Methotrexate, Digoxin.

name: Pantoprazole (بانتوبرازول / بانتوب)
uses: GERD, peptic ulcer, H. pylori, Zollinger-Ellison. حموضة المعدة - أقل تأثيراً على الكلوبيدوغريل.
dosage: 20-40mg once daily before breakfast
side_effects: Headache, diarrhea, hypomagnesemia, C. diff risk.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Less CYP2C19 inhibition than omeprazole - preferred with clopidogrel.

name: Ranitidine / Famotidine (رانيتيدين / فاموتيدين)
uses: Peptic ulcer, GERD, dyspepsia. Less effective than PPIs but faster onset for symptoms.
dosage: Ranitidine 150mg BID or 300mg HS. Famotidine 20-40mg BID.
side_effects: Headache, constipation, diarrhea, confusion (elderly). (Ranitidine recalled 2020 due to NDMA)
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. (Use famotidine - ranitidine recalled)
interactions: Antacids (reduce absorption), Ketoconazole, Atazanavir.

name: Ondansetron (أوندانسيترون / زوفران)
uses: Chemotherapy-induced nausea, post-op nausea, gastroenteritis. غثيان العلاج الكيماوي.
dosage: 4-8mg oral/IV/IM every 4-8 hours. Max 32mg/day
side_effects: Headache, constipation, QT prolongation (IV), blurred vision.
contraindications: Congenital long QT syndrome, apomorphine use.
interactions: QT-prolonging drugs, Tramadol (reduces analgesic effect), SSRIs (serotonin syndrome rare).
pregnancy_safety: Category B (some concerns with first trimester)

name: Metoclopramide (ميتوكلوبراميد / بريميران)
uses: Nausea, vomiting, gastroparesis, GERD. غثيان وتقيؤ وبطء المعدة.
dosage: 10mg 3 times daily before meals. Max 12 weeks.
side_effects: Tardive dyskinesia (long-term use - FDA black box), drowsiness, akathisia, hyperprolactinemia.
contraindications: Parkinson's disease, GI obstruction/perforation, pheochromocytoma.
interactions: Dopamine agonists (Parkinson's drugs), Opioids, Anticholinergics.

name: Domperidone (دومبيريدون / موتيليوم)
uses: Nausea, vomiting, gastroparesis. Does not cross BBB (fewer CNS effects).
dosage: 10mg 3 times daily before meals
side_effects: QT prolongation, galactorrhea, headache. Cardiac risk in elderly and high doses.
contraindications: Hepatic impairment, QT prolongation, pituitary tumors.
interactions: QT-prolonging drugs, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Lactulose (لاكتولوز / دولاكس)
uses: Constipation, hepatic encephalopathy (reduces ammonia). إمساك وأمونيا الكبد.
dosage: Constipation: 15-30mL once or twice daily. Hepatic encephalopathy: 30-45mL 3-4 times daily.
side_effects: Flatulence, bloating, abdominal cramps, diarrhea (excess). غازات ومغص.
contraindications: Galactosemia, bowel obstruction.
interactions: Other laxatives, antibiotics (may reduce lactulose efficacy in HE).

name: Bisacodyl (بيساكوديل / دولكولاكس)
uses: Constipation, bowel preparation. إمساك وتحضير الأمعاء.
dosage: 5-10mg oral at night; 10mg rectal
side_effects: Abdominal cramps, diarrhea, electrolyte imbalance (long-term). مغص.
contraindications: Bowel obstruction, appendicitis, dehydration.
interactions: Milk/antacids within 1 hour (dissolve coating).

name: Mesalazine / 5-ASA (ميسالازين / بنتاسا)
uses: Ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease (some). التهاب القولون التقرحي.
dosage: 1.6-4g/day in divided doses (maintenance: 1.2-2.4g/day)
side_effects: Nausea, headache, rash, nephrotoxicity (rare), pancreatitis (rare).
contraindications: Severe renal impairment, aspirin/salicylate allergy.
interactions: Warfarin, Azathioprine (increase toxicity).

name: Sertraline (سيرترالين / زولوفت)
uses: Depression, OCD, PTSD, panic disorder, social anxiety, PMDD. اكتئاب وقلق.
dosage: 50-200mg once daily. Start 25-50mg, increase after 1-2 weeks.
side_effects: Nausea (initial), insomnia, sexual dysfunction, diarrhea, serotonin syndrome (rare). خلل جنسي.
contraindications: MAOIs (within 14 days), Pimozide, Linezolid.
interactions: MAOIs (serotonin syndrome), Warfarin, Tramadol, Triptans, other serotonergics.
pregnancy_safety: Category C (use if benefit > risk; neonatal adaptation syndrome)

name: Escitalopram (إسيتالوبرام / سيبرالكس)
uses: Depression, generalized anxiety disorder. أفضل تحمل بين الـSSRIs. اكتئاب وقلق عام.
dosage: 10-20mg once daily. Elderly: start 5mg.
side_effects: Nausea, insomnia, sexual dysfunction, QT prolongation (>20mg or in elderly).
contraindications: MAOIs, Pimozide, QT prolongation, doses >20mg in elderly.
interactions: MAOIs, QT-prolonging drugs, Warfarin, Tramadol.

name: Fluoxetine (فلوكسيتين / بروزاك)
uses: Depression, OCD, bulimia nervosa, panic disorder, PMDD. اكتئاب، وسواس، شره مرضي.
dosage: 20-60mg once daily (morning). Long half-life (washout not needed for MAOIs - wait 5 weeks)
side_effects: Nausea, insomnia, anxiety (initial), sexual dysfunction, weight loss initially.
contraindications: MAOIs (wait 14 days after MAOI; 5 weeks after fluoxetine before MAOI).
interactions: MAOIs, Tramadol, Warfarin, TCAs (increase levels significantly), Pimozide.

name: Alprazolam (ألبرازولام / زاناكس)
uses: Anxiety disorders, panic disorder, short-term anxiety relief. قلق ونوبات هلع.
dosage: 0.25-0.5mg 3 times daily. Panic: up to 10mg/day (divided). Use shortest duration.
side_effects: Sedation, cognitive impairment, dependence/addiction, withdrawal (dangerous - seizures), respiratory depression. إدمان وانسحاب خطير.
contraindications: Acute narrow-angle glaucoma, severe respiratory depression, sleep apnea, pregnancy.
interactions: Alcohol (fatal), CNS depressants, Opioids, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Diazepam (ديازيبام / فاليوم)
uses: Anxiety, muscle spasm, alcohol withdrawal, seizures, pre-op sedation. قلق ومسكن للعضلات.
dosage: Anxiety: 2-10mg 2-4 times daily. Seizures: 5-10mg IV. Alcohol withdrawal: 10-20mg oral.
side_effects: Sedation, dependence, withdrawal (life-threatening), respiratory depression, paradoxical aggression.
contraindications: Respiratory depression, sleep apnea, severe hepatic failure, myasthenia gravis.
interactions: Alcohol, Opioids, CNS depressants, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Olanzapine (أولانزابين / زيبريكسا)
uses: Schizophrenia, bipolar disorder mania, treatment-resistant depression (adjunct). انفصام وثنائي القطب.
dosage: 5-20mg once daily (oral). IM for acute agitation.
side_effects: Metabolic syndrome (weight gain, hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia), sedation, tardive dyskinesia, orthostatic hypotension.
contraindications: Dementia with behavioral symptoms (increased mortality), narrow-angle glaucoma.
interactions: CNS depressants, Fluvoxamine, Carbamazepine, Ciprofloxacin.

name: Quetiapine (كيتيابين / سيروكويل)
uses: Schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression (adjunct). اضطرابات ثنائية القطب والانفصام.
dosage: Schizophrenia: 150-750mg/day. Bipolar: 300-800mg/day. Depression adjunct: 50-300mg.
side_effects: Sedation, weight gain, metabolic effects, orthostatic hypotension, QT prolongation.
contraindications: Dementia (increased mortality risk).
interactions: CNS depressants, CYP3A4 inhibitors, QT-prolonging drugs.

name: Haloperidol (هالوبيريدول / هالدول)
uses: Schizophrenia, acute psychosis, delirium, Tourette's, intractable hiccups. الذهان الحاد والهذيان.
dosage: Oral: 0.5-5mg 2-3 times daily. IM: 2-5mg for acute agitation.
side_effects: EPS (dystonia, parkinsonism, akathisia, tardive dyskinesia), QT prolongation, NMS (rare but deadly).
contraindications: Parkinson's disease, severe CNS depression, NMS history, QT prolongation.
interactions: QT-prolonging drugs, CNS depressants, Lithium, Rifampicin.

name: Valproate / Valproic Acid (فالبروات / ديباكين)
uses: Epilepsy (all types), bipolar mania, migraine prophylaxis. صرع وثنائي القطب.
dosage: 750-1500mg/day in 2-3 divided doses. Therapeutic level: 50-100mcg/mL
side_effects: Weight gain, hair loss, tremor, hepatotoxicity (children <2y), pancreatitis, neural tube defects (pregnancy!).
contraindications: Pregnancy (neural tube defects - Category X), liver disease, urea cycle disorders.
interactions: Carbamazepine, Lamotrigine (increase levels), Aspirin, Warfarin, Rifampicin.
pregnancy_safety: Category X in some countries — major teratogen

name: Carbamazepine (كاربامازيبين / تيجريتول)
uses: Epilepsy (focal, generalized), trigeminal neuralgia, bipolar disorder. صرع وألم ثلاثي التوائم.
dosage: 200-1200mg/day in 2-4 divided doses. Therapeutic level: 4-12mcg/mL
side_effects: Dizziness, ataxia, diplopia (dose-related), SJS/TEN (HLA-B*1502 risk - Asians), hyponatremia, agranulocytosis.
contraindications: MAOIs, history of bone marrow suppression, AV block, porphyria.
interactions: MASSIVE inducer of CYP3A4, 2C9, 1A2. Reduces many drug levels. Interacts with 100+ drugs.

name: Levetiracetam (ليفيتيراسيتام / كيبرا)
uses: Focal and generalized epilepsy, adjunctive. صرع - أقل تفاعلات مع الأدوية الأخرى.
dosage: 500-3000mg/day in 2 divided doses
side_effects: Behavioral/psychiatric (irritability, depression - 10-15%), somnolence, dizziness.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Few interactions (not CYP metabolized). Caution with CNS depressants.

name: Pregabalin (بريجابالين / ليريكا)
uses: Neuropathic pain (diabetic neuropathy, PHN), fibromyalgia, epilepsy (adjunct), GAD. ألم الأعصاب وألياف عضلي.
dosage: 150-600mg/day in 2-3 divided doses
side_effects: Dizziness, somnolence, weight gain, edema, blurred vision, dependence (some).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Caution in renal impairment (reduce dose).
interactions: CNS depressants, Alcohol, Opioids (respiratory depression risk), ACE inhibitors.

name: Gabapentin (جابابنتين / نيورونتين)
uses: Neuropathic pain, postherpetic neuralgia, epilepsy (adjunct), restless legs. ألم الأعصاب.
dosage: 900-3600mg/day in 3 divided doses. Titrate slowly.
side_effects: Dizziness, somnolence, ataxia, weight gain, peripheral edema, dependence.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Antacids (reduce absorption - separate 2h), CNS depressants, Morphine.

name: Amitriptyline (أميتريبتيلين / إلافيل)
uses: Depression, neuropathic pain, migraine prophylaxis, IBS, insomnia (low dose). الاكتئاب وألم الأعصاب.
dosage: Depression: 75-200mg/day. Neuropathic pain: 10-75mg at night. Migraine: 10-25mg nightly.
side_effects: Anticholinergic (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision), sedation, weight gain, QT prolongation, cardiac arrhythmias (overdose toxic).
contraindications: Recent MI, heart block, MAOIs (within 14 days), acute angle glaucoma, BPH.
interactions: MAOIs (fatal), SSRIs (serotonin syndrome + TCA toxicity), sympathomimetics, CNS depressants.

name: Lithium (ليثيوم / كانتيليث)
uses: Bipolar disorder (gold standard for mania/maintenance), treatment-resistant depression augmentation, suicide prevention.
dosage: 900-1800mg/day in divided doses. Therapeutic level: 0.6-1.2mEq/L. Monitor regularly!
side_effects: Tremor, polyuria, polydipsia, weight gain, hypothyroidism, renal toxicity (long-term), acne.
contraindications: Severe renal impairment, pregnancy (Category D - Ebstein's anomaly), dehydration, low sodium diet.
interactions: NSAIDs (increase levels - toxicity), ACE inhibitors, Thiazides, Haloperidol.

name: Donepezil (دونيبيزيل / أريسيبت)
uses: Alzheimer's disease (mild to severe), other dementias. علاج الزهايمر.
dosage: 5mg once daily at bedtime; after 4-6 weeks increase to 10mg if tolerated
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, insomnia, muscle cramps, bradycardia, syncope.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, sick sinus syndrome/heart block (caution), peptic ulcer.
interactions: NSAIDs, Beta-blockers, Anticholinergic drugs (reduce effect), Succinylcholine.

name: Sumatriptan (سوماتريبتان / إيميغران)
uses: Acute migraine attack, cluster headaches. علاج نوبة الصداع النصفي.
dosage: 50-100mg oral; 6mg SC; 20mg nasal. May repeat after 2 hours (max 200mg oral/day)
side_effects: Chest tightness/pressure (not cardiac usually), flushing, tingling, dizziness, injection site pain.
contraindications: Coronary artery disease, uncontrolled hypertension, hemiplegic/basilar migraine, MAOIs.
interactions: MAOIs (serotonin syndrome), SSRIs, Ergotamine, other triptans.

name: Levothyroxine (ليفوثيروكسين / إيلتروكسين)
uses: Hypothyroidism, thyroid hormone replacement, TSH suppression in thyroid cancer. قصور الغدة الدرقية.
dosage: Adults: 25-200mcg once daily (30-60 min before breakfast). Start low in elderly/cardiac.
side_effects: Overdose: palpitations, weight loss, sweating, insomnia, tremor. تسرع القلب عند الجرعة الزائدة.
contraindications: Untreated adrenal insufficiency, acute MI (caution), thyrotoxicosis.
interactions: Calcium, Iron, Antacids (separate 4h), Cholestyramine, PPIs, Warfarin (increase INR).
alternatives: Liothyronine (T3 - rarely used alone), Desiccated thyroid

name: Carbimazole (كاربيمازول / نيو-ميركازول)
uses: Hyperthyroidism, Graves' disease, thyroid storm. فرط نشاط الغدة الدرقية.
dosage: 20-60mg/day initially in divided doses; reduce to maintenance 5-20mg/day
side_effects: Agranulocytosis (rare but serious - stop if fever/sore throat), rash, headache, GI, hepatitis.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, breastfeeding (some guidelines - use PTU).
interactions: Warfarin (alter INR), Beta-blockers, Digoxin.
alternatives: Propylthiouracil (PTU - preferred in 1st trimester), Radioiodine, Surgery

name: Prednisolone (بريدنيزولون / ميدروكورت)
uses: Inflammation, asthma, allergic reactions, autoimmune diseases, COPD exacerbation, IBD. التهاب وحساسية وأمراض المناعة.
dosage: 5-60mg/day depending on condition. Taper slowly if >3 weeks treatment.
side_effects: Cushingoid features, hyperglycemia, osteoporosis, adrenal suppression, hypertension, weight gain, cataracts, increased infection risk.
contraindications: Systemic fungal infection, live vaccines (on immunosuppressive doses).
interactions: NSAIDs (GI bleeding), Warfarin, Hypoglycemics, Live vaccines, Rifampicin.

name: Dexamethasone (ديكساميثازون / ديكادرون)
uses: Cerebral edema, nausea prevention (chemo), croup, COVID-19 (severe), fetal lung maturation. وذمة المخ والغثيان.
dosage: 0.5-20mg/day depending on indication. Cerebral edema: 10mg IV then 4mg q6h.
side_effects: Hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, adrenal suppression, osteoporosis, psychiatric effects.
contraindications: Systemic fungal infection, live vaccines, hypersensitivity.
interactions: NSAIDs, CYP3A4 inducers (Rifampicin), Hypoglycemics, Live vaccines.

name: Hydrocortisone (هيدروكورتيزون / كورتيزول)
uses: Adrenal insufficiency (replacement), allergic reactions, anaphylaxis (IV), inflammatory skin conditions. قصور الغدة الكظرية.
dosage: Replacement: 15-25mg/day (split). Emergency: 100-500mg IV stat.
side_effects: Similar to prednisolone. IV: hypertension, hyperglycemia.
contraindications: Systemic fungal infection (high doses).
interactions: NSAIDs, Warfarin, Hypoglycemics, Live vaccines, Rifampicin.

name: Testosterone (تستوستيرون / سسترون)
uses: Male hypogonadism, delayed puberty, gender affirming therapy. قصور الغدد التناسلية الذكورية.
dosage: IM: 200-400mg every 2-4 weeks. Gel: 50-100mg/day. Patch: 2.5-7.5mg/day.
side_effects: Polycythemia, prostate enlargement, acne, hair loss, infertility (suppresses spermatogenesis), sleep apnea.
contraindications: Prostate cancer, breast cancer, pregnancy, polycythemia.
interactions: Warfarin (increase INR), Insulin, Cyclosporine.

name: Combined Oral Contraceptive Pill (حبوب منع الحمل)
uses: Contraception, dysmenorrhea, endometriosis, PCOS, acne. منع الحمل وتنظيمه.
dosage: One pill daily at same time. 21-day or 28-day packs.
side_effects: Nausea, breast tenderness, breakthrough bleeding, mood changes, VTE risk, hypertension (rare), decreased libido.
contraindications: VTE history, stroke, migraine with aura, breast cancer, liver disease, smokers >35yo, uncontrolled HTN.
interactions: Rifampicin (major - reduces effectiveness), Carbamazepine, Phenytoin, St. John's Wort.

name: Progesterone (بروجيستيرون)
uses: Luteal phase support (IVF), preterm labor prevention, HRT, amenorrhea. دعم الحمل والعلاج الهرموني.
dosage: Vaginal: 200-400mg daily. Oral: 100-300mg at night. IM: 25-100mg.
side_effects: Drowsiness, dizziness, breast tenderness, nausea.
contraindications: Undiagnosed vaginal bleeding, breast cancer, thromboembolic disorders.
interactions: Rifampicin, Carbamazepine (reduce levels).
pregnancy_safety: Category B (vaginal) / C (oral) — Used to support pregnancy

name: Tramadol (ترامادول / ترالجيك)
uses: Moderate to severe pain. ألم متوسط إلى شديد. دواء خاضع للرقابة.
dosage: 50-100mg every 4-6 hours. Max 400mg/day. Controlled substance!
side_effects: Nausea, dizziness, constipation, seizures (especially overdose or SSRIs), serotonin syndrome, dependence.
contraindications: Seizure disorder, MAOI use, children <12yo (severe respiratory depression), uncontrolled epilepsy.
interactions: SSRIs/SNRIs (serotonin syndrome + seizures), MAOIs, CNS depressants, Ondansetron.

name: Morphine (مورفين)
uses: Severe acute pain, cancer pain, palliative care, acute pulmonary edema. ألم السرطان والطوارئ.
dosage: Oral: 5-20mg every 4h. IV: 2-5mg slowly (titrate). Controlled Drug.
side_effects: Respiratory depression (overdose risk), constipation, nausea, sedation, dependence, urinary retention.
contraindications: Respiratory depression, paralytic ileus, head injury (masks symptoms), MAOIs.
interactions: CNS depressants, MAOIs, Naloxone (reversal agent).

name: Naproxen (نابروكسين / نابروسين)
uses: Arthritis, pain, dysmenorrhea, gout, headache. التهاب المفاصل وتخفيف الألم.
dosage: 250-500mg twice daily. Max 1250mg/day. Take with food.
side_effects: GI bleeding, ulcers, renal impairment, CV events, fluid retention, edema.
contraindications: Active GI bleeding, severe renal/hepatic failure, post-CABG, aspirin allergy.
interactions: Warfarin, ACE inhibitors, Lithium, Methotrexate, Corticosteroids.
alternatives: Ibuprofen, Diclofenac, Celecoxib (COX-2 - lower GI risk)

name: Celecoxib (سيليكوكسيب / سيليبريكس)
uses: Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, dysmenorrhea. التهاب المفاصل مع حماية المعدة.
dosage: 100-200mg twice daily or 200mg once daily
side_effects: GI (lower risk than non-selective NSAIDs), increased CV risk (similar), edema, hypertension.
contraindications: Sulfonamide allergy, post-CABG, active GI bleeding, severe renal/hepatic disease.
interactions: Warfarin (CYP2C9 inhibitor), ACE inhibitors, Lithium, Fluconazole.

name: Colchicine (كولشيسين / كولكريس)
uses: Acute gout attack, gout prophylaxis, FMF, pericarditis. النقرس الحاد.
dosage: Acute gout: 1mg then 0.5mg 1 hour later. Prophylaxis: 0.5mg 1-2 times daily.
side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, myopathy (long-term), bone marrow suppression (overdose toxic!).
contraindications: Severe renal or hepatic impairment.
interactions: CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitors: Clarithromycin, Cyclosporine (can be fatal - reduce dose or avoid).

name: Allopurinol (ألوبيورينول / زيلوريك)
category: Xanthine Oxidase Inhibitor - Uric Acid Lowering
uses: Gout prevention (NOT for acute attacks), hyperuricemia, kidney stones (uric acid). الوقاية من النقرس.
dosage: 100-800mg/day (titrate based on uric acid levels). Start low to avoid gout flare.
side_effects: Rash (mild to severe SJS/TEN - rare), GI, hepatitis, hypersensitivity syndrome (HLA-B*5801 - Asian risk).
contraindications: Acute gout attack (wait 2-4 weeks). HLA-B*5801 testing in high-risk populations.
interactions: Azathioprine/Mercaptopurine (FATAL - reduce dose 75%), Ampicillin (rash), Warfarin.

name: Methotrexate (ميثوتريكسات / رواميثاكس)
uses: Rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, some cancers (higher doses), ectopic pregnancy. روماتيزم وصداف.
dosage: RA: 7.5-25mg once weekly (oral/SC). ALWAYS weekly, not daily (daily = fatal!). + Folic acid.
side_effects: Hepatotoxicity, bone marrow suppression, mucositis, pulmonary toxicity, teratogenicity (severe). تليف الكبد ونقص الدم.
contraindications: Pregnancy (Category X - major teratogen), breastfeeding, significant hepatic/renal impairment, alcoholism, bone marrow suppression.
interactions: NSAIDs/Aspirin (increase toxicity), Trimethoprim, Probenecid, Penicillins, Alcohol.

name: Hydroxychloroquine (هيدروكسيكلوروكين / بلاكنيل)
uses: Rheumatoid arthritis, SLE, malaria prevention. الذئبة الحمراء والروماتيزم.
dosage: RA/SLE: 200-400mg/day. Max 5mg/kg/day (to reduce retinal toxicity). Malaria: varies.
side_effects: Retinal toxicity (long-term - annual eye exams needed), GI, skin discoloration, hemolysis (G6PD deficiency).
contraindications: Retinal disease, G6PD deficiency (malaria use).
interactions: QT-prolonging drugs, Digoxin, Cyclosporine.
pregnancy_safety: Category C (used in lupus/malaria - benefit > risk)

name: Doxycycline (دوكسيسيكلين / دوريكسات)
uses: Atypical pneumonia, Chlamydia, Lyme disease, acne, malaria prophylaxis, MRSA skin infections. التهابات الجهاز التنفسي والمسالك البولية.
dosage: 100mg twice daily (or 200mg loading dose first day). Take upright with full glass of water.
side_effects: Esophagitis (lie down within 30 min), photosensitivity, GI, discolors teeth (<8yo), teratogen.
contraindications: Pregnancy (2nd/3rd trimester), children <8 years, esophageal disorders.
interactions: Antacids/Dairy/Iron (reduce absorption), Warfarin, Oral contraceptives (slightly), Barbiturates.

name: Clarithromycin (كلاريثروميسين / كلاريد)
uses: Respiratory infections, H. pylori (triple therapy), MAC prophylaxis, skin infections. التهابات تنفسية وH.pylori.
dosage: 250-500mg twice daily for 7-14 days
side_effects: GI (metallic taste), QT prolongation, hepatotoxicity, drug interactions (major CYP3A4 inhibitor).
contraindications: QT prolongation, hypersensitivity, concurrent ergotamine, pimozide, simvastatin.
interactions: MAJOR CYP3A4 inhibitor. Colchicine (fatal), Statins, Digoxin, Warfarin, many others.

name: Cephalexin (سيفاليكسين / كيفليكس)
uses: Skin/soft tissue infections, UTI, strep throat, bone infections. التهابات الجلد والجهاز البولي.
dosage: 250-1000mg every 6 hours
side_effects: GI, rash, allergic reactions (10% cross-reactivity with penicillin allergy).
contraindications: Cephalosporin hypersensitivity. Caution in penicillin allergy.
interactions: Warfarin, Probenecid, Metformin (very slightly).

name: Ceftriaxone (سيفترياكسون / روسيفين)
uses: Severe bacterial infections: pneumonia, meningitis, gonorrhea, sepsis. التهابات خطيرة وسحايا.
dosage: 1-4g/day IV or IM once or twice daily
side_effects: Biliary sludge/gallstones, diarrhea (C. diff risk), hypersensitivity, pain at IM site.
contraindications: Neonates with jaundice (displaces bilirubin), hypercalcemic patients (Ca precipitate with IV Ca).
interactions: Calcium-containing IV solutions (precipitate).

name: Meropenem (ميروبينيم / ميرونيم)
uses: Severe hospital-acquired infections, multi-drug resistant organisms, meningitis (bacterial). المضاد للبكتيريا المقاومة.
dosage: 0.5-2g IV every 8 hours
side_effects: GI, seizures (high doses/renal impairment), thrombophlebitis, hypersensitivity.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to carbapenems. Caution with penicillin allergy (low cross-reactivity).
interactions: Valproate (reduces levels - may cause seizures!), Probenecid.

name: Vancomycin (فانكومايسين / فانكوسين)
uses: MRSA infections, C. difficile colitis (oral), serious gram-positive infections. العدوى بالمكورات المقاومة للميثيسيلين.
dosage: IV: 15-20mg/kg every 8-12h (AUC-guided dosing). Oral (C. diff): 125mg 4 times daily.
side_effects: Nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, 'Red Man Syndrome' (infuse slowly), thrombophlebitis.
contraindications: Vancomycin allergy.
interactions: Aminoglycosides (nephrotoxicity), Furosemide (ototoxicity), NSAIDs.

name: Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole / TMP-SMX (ترايميثوبريم+سلفاميثوكسازول / باكتريم)
uses: UTI, PCP prophylaxis, toxoplasmosis, MRSA skin infections (community), traveler's diarrhea. التهابات المسالك البولية.
dosage: UTI: 1 DS tablet (160/800mg) twice daily × 3-7 days. PCP treatment: higher doses.
side_effects: Rash (SJS/TEN risk), GI, hyperkalemia, nephrotoxicity, bone marrow suppression, hypoglycemia (sulfonamide).
contraindications: Sulfonamide allergy, severe renal/hepatic disease, G6PD deficiency (risk of hemolysis), pregnancy near term (kernicterus).
interactions: Warfarin (increase INR), Methotrexate (toxicity), ACE inhibitors (hyperkalemia), Phenytoin.

name: Nitrofurantoin (نيتروفيورانتوين / ماكروبيد)
uses: Uncomplicated UTI prophylaxis and treatment. ONLY for lower UTI - does not achieve tissue levels. التهاب المثانة غير المعقد.
dosage: MacroBID: 100mg twice daily × 5-7 days. Prophylaxis: 50-100mg at bedtime.
side_effects: GI (take with food), pulmonary reactions (long-term), peripheral neuropathy, hepatotoxicity (rare), brown urine.
contraindications: eGFR<30 (ineffective and accumulates), pregnancy at term (hemolytic anemia in neonate), G6PD deficiency.
interactions: Antacids (reduce absorption), Probenecid (increase levels).

name: Acyclovir (أسيكلوفير / زوفيراكس)
uses: Herpes simplex, chickenpox (varicella), herpes zoster, genital herpes, herpes encephalitis. الهرببس والجدري.
dosage: Oral: 200-800mg 5 times daily (depending on indication). IV: 5-10mg/kg every 8h (serious infections).
side_effects: GI, headache, nephrotoxicity (IV - adequate hydration needed), encephalopathy (rare, renal failure).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: Probenecid, Zidovudine, Nephrotoxic drugs.

name: Oseltamivir (أوسيلتاميفير / تاميفلو)
uses: Influenza A and B treatment and prophylaxis. Start within 48 hours of symptoms. أنفلونزا علاج ووقاية.
dosage: Treatment: 75mg twice daily × 5 days. Prophylaxis: 75mg once daily × 10 days.
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting (take with food), headache, psychiatric effects (especially children - behavioral changes).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Renal adjustment needed.
interactions: Live attenuated influenza vaccine (avoid 2 days before/after).

name: Tenofovir (تينوفوفير / فيريد)
uses: HIV treatment (part of combination ART), chronic Hepatitis B. فيروس نقص المناعة والتهاب الكبد B.
dosage: 300mg once daily (with or without food)
side_effects: Nephrotoxicity, bone density loss (Fanconi syndrome), GI.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Avoid with other nephrotoxic drugs.
interactions: Didanosine (increase), NSAIDs (renal risk), Adefovir.
alternatives: TAF (Tenofovir Alafenamide - less renal/bone toxicity), Abacavir
pregnancy_safety: Category B — Recommended in HIV+ pregnant women

name: Itraconazole (إيتراكونازول / سبورانوكس)
uses: Aspergillosis, blastomycosis, histoplasmosis, onychomycosis (nail fungus), candidiasis. فطريات الأظافر والرئة.
dosage: 100-400mg/day (absorption requires food and acid). Nail fungus: 200mg twice daily × 1 week/month (pulse).
side_effects: Hepatotoxicity, heart failure (negative inotropy - avoid in HF), GI, QT prolongation, edema.
contraindications: Heart failure, ventricular dysfunction, pregnancy (onychomycosis - wait until after delivery).
interactions: MAJOR CYP3A4 inhibitor. Simvastatin, Cisapride, Pimozide, Midazolam, many others.

name: Terbinafine (تيربينافين / لاميسيل)
uses: Dermatophyte infections: nail fungus (onychomycosis), tinea, ringworm. أكثر فعالية للفطريات الجلدية.
dosage: Onychomycosis: 250mg once daily × 6 weeks (fingernail) or 12 weeks (toenail). Skin: 1% cream 1-2 weeks.
side_effects: GI, taste disturbance/loss, rash, hepatotoxicity (rare - monitor LFTs), SJS (very rare).
contraindications: Liver disease, hypersensitivity.
interactions: CYP2D6 inhibitor. Tricyclic antidepressants, SSRIs, Warfarin, Rifampicin.

name: Albendazole (ألبيندازول / زنتيل)
uses: Intestinal worms (roundworm, hookworm, tapeworm), neurocysticercosis, hydatid disease. الديدان المعوية.
dosage: Intestinal worms: 400mg single dose. Hydatid disease: 400mg twice daily × 28 days (cycles).
side_effects: GI, headache, dizziness, transient liver enzyme elevation, alopecia (long-term), bone marrow suppression.
contraindications: Pregnancy (Category C - avoid), hypersensitivity.
interactions: Cimetidine, Praziquantel, Dexamethasone (increase albendazole levels).

name: Chloroquine (كلوروكين / أرالين)
uses: Malaria treatment/prophylaxis, SLE, rheumatoid arthritis, amoebic liver abscess. ملاريا وأمراض مناعية.
dosage: Malaria: 600mg base initially, then 300mg at 6h, 24h, 48h. Prophylaxis: 300mg weekly.
side_effects: GI, retinal toxicity (long-term - annual eye exams), pruritus (especially in dark skin), QT prolongation, cardiomyopathy.
contraindications: Retinal disease, G6PD deficiency (risk of hemolysis).
interactions: QT-prolonging drugs, Digoxin, Penicillamine, Antacids (reduce absorption).
pregnancy_safety: Category C (used for malaria in pregnancy)

name: Tretinoin (ترتينوين / ريتين-A)
uses: Acne vulgaris, photodamage, fine wrinkles, keratosis pilaris. حب الشباب وعلامات الشيخوخة الجلدية.
dosage: Topical: apply thin layer at night (0.025-0.1% cream). Start low, increase gradually.
side_effects: Skin irritation, redness, peeling, photosensitivity, initial acne flare.
contraindications: Eczema/rosacea (use with caution), sunburn, pregnancy (Category X - isotretinoin risk is far higher; topical tretinoin Category C).
interactions: Benzoyl peroxide (inactivate each other - use at different times), other topical retinoids.

name: Isotretinoin (إيزوتريتينوين / أكوتان)
uses: Severe nodular acne, treatment-resistant acne. حب الشباب الشديد.
dosage: 0.5-1mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses × 16-24 weeks. Cumulative dose: 120-150mg/kg.
side_effects: Extremely dry skin/lips/eyes, elevated triglycerides, hepatotoxicity, depression, IBD, skeletal effects. Powerful teratogen.
contraindications: Pregnancy (mandatory 2 negative pregnancy tests before starting, monthly during, 1 month after - iPLEDGE program). Breastfeeding.
interactions: Tetracyclines (pseudotumor cerebri), Vitamin A supplements, Methotrexate.
alternatives: Topical tretinoin + antibiotics for less severe acne

name: Betamethasone Topical (بيتاميثازون موضعي / ديبروزون)
uses: Eczema, psoriasis, contact dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis. أمراض الجلد الالتهابية.
dosage: Apply thin layer 1-2 times daily. Use for shortest duration necessary. Avoid face, groin, axillae.
side_effects: Skin atrophy, striae, purpura, telangiectasia, adrenal suppression (large areas), perioral dermatitis.
contraindications: Acne vulgaris, rosacea, perioral dermatitis, infected skin, skin conditions in children <12 years (face).
interactions: Other topical steroids.

name: Mupirocin (موبيروسين / باكترواباين)
uses: Impetigo, skin infections (Staph/Strep), MRSA nasal decolonization. جراثيم الجلد السطحية.
dosage: Apply 3 times daily × 5-10 days. Nasal: apply inside nostrils twice daily × 5 days.
side_effects: Local burning, stinging, itching. Systemic absorption minimal.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity.
interactions: None significant (topical).
alternatives: Fusidic acid, Retapamulin, Systemic antibiotics for widespread infection

name: Timolol Eye Drops (تيمولول قطرة عين)
uses: Glaucoma, ocular hypertension. ضغط العين والجلوكوما.
dosage: 0.25-0.5% one drop in affected eye(s) twice daily
side_effects: Systemic absorption: bradycardia, bronchospasm, hypotension. Local: burning, stinging.
contraindications: Asthma, COPD, sinus bradycardia, heart block, heart failure.
interactions: Systemic beta-blockers, CCBs, Digoxin.

name: Latanoprost Eye Drops (لاتانوبروست / زالاتان)
uses: Open-angle glaucoma, ocular hypertension. ضغط العين - الجلوكوما.
dosage: 0.005% one drop in affected eye(s) once daily (evening)
side_effects: Iris/eyelid darkening (permanent), eyelash growth, ocular irritation, blurred vision.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, intraocular inflammation.
interactions: Thimerosal-containing drops (precipitate - separate by 5 min).

name: Ciprofloxacin Eye Drops (سيبروفلوكساسين قطرة عين)
uses: Bacterial conjunctivitis, corneal ulcer. التهاب الملتحمة الجرثومي.
dosage: 1-2 drops in affected eye(s) every 2-4 hours (severe) or 4 times daily
side_effects: Local burning, stinging, crusting of eyelids, white precipitate (corneal ulcer - disappears).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to quinolones.
interactions: None significant (ophthalmic).
alternatives: Chloramphenicol eye drops, Tobramycin eye drops, Moxifloxacin eye drops

name: Tamsulosin (تامسولوسين / فلوماكس)
uses: Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), ureteral stones (passage facilitation). تضخم البروستاتا الحميد.
dosage: 0.4mg once daily after morning meal
side_effects: Orthostatic hypotension (especially first dose), retrograde ejaculation, dizziness, rhinitis.
contraindications: Intraoperative Floppy Iris Syndrome (IFIS) - inform ophthalmologist before cataract surgery!
interactions: Other alpha-blockers, PDE5 inhibitors (Sildenafil - severe hypotension), CYP2D6/3A4 inhibitors.

name: Finasteride (فيناستيريد / بروسكار)
uses: BPH (Proscar 5mg), male pattern baldness (Propecia 1mg). تضخم البروستاتا وتساقط الشعر.
dosage: BPH: 5mg once daily. Alopecia: 1mg once daily. Takes 3-6 months to see effect.
side_effects: Sexual: decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, ejaculatory disorders, gynecomastia. Post-finasteride syndrome (controversial).
contraindications: Women (Category X - female fetus feminization risk), children. Women should not handle crushed tablets.
interactions: None significant.
pregnancy_safety: Category X (for women of childbearing potential)

name: Sildenafil (سيلدينافيل / فياجرا)
uses: Erectile dysfunction, pulmonary arterial hypertension (Revatio). ضعف الانتصاب وارتفاع ضغط الرئة.
dosage: ED: 50mg 30-60 min before sex (range 25-100mg). Pulm. HTN: 20mg 3 times daily.
side_effects: Headache, flushing, visual disturbances (blue tinge), dyspepsia, nasal congestion, hypotension.
contraindications: Nitrates (ABSOLUTE - fatal hypotension), alpha-blockers (caution), recent stroke/MI, severe hepatic disease.
interactions: Nitrates (FATAL), Alpha-blockers, CYP3A4 inhibitors, Ritonavir.

name: Vitamin D3 (فيتامين د / كولكالسيفيرول)
uses: Vitamin D deficiency, rickets, osteoporosis prevention, bone health, immune support. نقص فيتامين د.
dosage: Deficiency: 1000-5000 IU/day or 50,000 IU weekly × 8-12 weeks. Maintenance: 600-2000 IU/day.
side_effects: Hypercalcemia (toxicity with very high doses): nausea, confusion, kidney stones, weakness.
contraindications: Hypercalcemia, granulomatous diseases (sarcoidosis), Williams syndrome.
interactions: Thiazides (increase calcium), Digoxin (hypercalcemia increases toxicity), Corticosteroids (reduce absorption).

name: Ferrous Sulfate - Iron (حديد / كبريتات الحديدوز)
uses: Iron deficiency anemia. فقر الدم بسبب نقص الحديد. شائع في الحمل والنساء.
dosage: 200mg (65mg elemental iron) 1-3 times daily on empty stomach. Take with vitamin C to enhance absorption.
side_effects: GI: constipation, dark stools, nausea, abdominal pain. Black stools (normal). Teeth staining (liquid).
contraindications: Hemochromatosis, hemolytic anemia, receiving parenteral iron.
interactions: Tetracyclines/Quinolones (separate 2-3h), Antacids, Calcium (reduce absorption), Levodopa, Methyldopa.
alternatives: Ferrous gluconate (better tolerated), IV iron (severe deficiency/malabsorption)

name: Folic Acid (حمض الفوليك)
uses: Neural tube defect prevention (pregnancy), megaloblastic anemia, methotrexate adjunct. نقص حمض الفوليك والحمل.
dosage: Neural tube prevention: 0.4-0.8mg/day (5mg/day if high risk). Deficiency: 5mg/day.
side_effects: Generally very safe. High doses may mask B12 deficiency.
contraindications: Caution with untreated B12 deficiency (neurological damage may worsen).
interactions: Methotrexate antagonizes folate (supplement needed), Anticonvulsants (reduce folate levels).
alternatives: Folinic acid (leucovorin - active form, for methotrexate rescue)
pregnancy_safety: Category A — Recommended in all pregnant women

name: Cyanocobalamin / Vitamin B12 (فيتامين ب12)
uses: B12 deficiency, pernicious anemia, neuropathy. نقص فيتامين ب12 وفقر الدم الخبيث.
dosage: Oral: 500-1000mcg/day (for dietary deficiency). IM: 1000mcg daily × 7 days then weekly × 4 then monthly (pernicious anemia).
side_effects: Very safe. IV/IM: rarely anaphylaxis (cyanocobalamin).
contraindications: Leber's disease (optic atrophy), sensitivity to cobalt.
interactions: Colchicine, Metformin, PPIs, H2 blockers (reduce absorption).

name: Calcium Carbonate (كربونات الكالسيوم / كالسيوم أكتيف)
uses: Calcium deficiency, osteoporosis prevention, hyperphosphatemia (renal disease), heartburn antacid.
dosage: Supplement: 500-1500mg elemental calcium/day. Antacid: 500-1500mg PRN.
side_effects: Constipation, bloating, hypercalcemia (excess), kidney stones (predisposed patients).
contraindications: Hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, nephrolithiasis, sarcoidosis.
interactions: Iron, Tetracyclines, Fluoroquinolones (reduce absorption - separate 2h), Levothyroxine, Digoxin.
alternatives: Calcium citrate (better absorbed without food), Calcium gluconate

name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids / Fish Oil (أوميغا 3)
uses: Hypertriglyceridemia, cardiovascular protection, anti-inflammatory. تخفيض الدهون الثلاثية.
dosage: 1-4g/day (EPA+DHA). Prescription strength (Vascepa): 4g/day for triglycerides.
side_effects: Fish burp, GI (take with meals), bleeding risk (high doses), glucose increase (minor).
contraindications: Fish/seafood allergy.
interactions: Warfarin (may increase bleeding risk at high doses), Antiplatelet drugs.

name: Oxytocin (أوكسيتوسين / سينتوسينون)
uses: Labor induction/augmentation, postpartum hemorrhage prevention/treatment, uterine atony. تحفيز الولادة وعلاج نزيف ما بعد الولادة.
dosage: IV infusion: 0.5-4 mU/min (labor). PPH: 10 units IM or IV.
side_effects: Uterine hyperstimulation, fetal distress, nausea, hypotension (bolus IV), water retention (oxytocin-like effect on kidneys).
contraindications: Cephalopelvic disproportion, fetal distress, placenta previa (absolute).
interactions: Oxytocics (additive), Prostaglandins, Vasoconstrictors.

name: Misoprostol (ميزوبروستول / سايتوتك)
uses: Peptic ulcer prevention (with NSAIDs/misoprostol combo), medical abortion (with mifepristone), labor induction, PPH treatment, miscarriage management. تحريض الإجهاض ومنع قرحة المعدة.
dosage: Ulcer: 200mcg 4 times daily with meals. Obstetric: varies (25-200mcg vaginal/sublingual).
side_effects: Diarrhea, abdominal cramps, uterine hyperstimulation (obstetric use), pyrexia, chills.
contraindications: Previous uterine surgery/C-section (relative risk of rupture in labor), unmonitored labor induction.
interactions: Oxytocin, antacids.

name: Clomifene / Clomiphene (كلوميفين / كلوميد)
category: Selective Estrogen Receptor Modulator - Ovulation Induction
uses: Anovulatory infertility, PCOS, ovulation induction. تحريض الإباضة وعلاج العقم عند المرأة.
dosage: 50-150mg/day for 5 days, starting day 3-5 of cycle
side_effects: Hot flashes, bloating, abdominal discomfort, multiple pregnancies (5-10%), ovarian hyperstimulation, visual disturbances (stop if).
contraindications: Pregnancy, liver disease, ovarian cysts, undiagnosed uterine bleeding, primary pituitary failure.
interactions: Gonadotrophins.
alternatives: Letrozole (better in PCOS), FSH injections, IVF

name: Amoxicillin Oral Suspension (أموكسيسيلين شراب - للأطفال)
uses: Ear infections (AOM), strep throat, pneumonia, UTI in children. التهاب الأذن الوسطى عند الأطفال.
dosage: Standard: 40-45mg/kg/day in 2-3 divided doses × 7-10 days. AOM high-dose: 80-90mg/kg/day.
side_effects: Diarrhea, rash (common - 5-10%, often non-allergic), thrush.
contraindications: Penicillin allergy.
interactions: Warfarin, Methotrexate, oral contraceptives.

name: Paracetamol Children's (بنادول أطفال)
uses: Fever, pain in children and infants. حرارة الأطفال والآلام.
dosage: 10-15mg/kg/dose every 4-6 hours. Max 5 doses/24h. NOT for <2 months without advice.
side_effects: Very safe at correct doses. Liver toxicity with overdose.
contraindications: Liver disease, paracetamol allergy.
interactions: Warfarin (minor), Alcohol (theoretical liver risk).

name: Ibuprofen Suspension (إيبوبروفين شراب - للأطفال)
uses: Fever ≥39°C, pain in children >3 months. حرارة شديدة وألم الأطفال.
dosage: 5-10mg/kg/dose every 6-8 hours. Max 40mg/kg/day. Not for <3 months or <5kg.
side_effects: GI irritation, renal impairment (dehydrated children), allergic reactions.
contraindications: <3 months, dehydration, renal disease, aspirin-sensitive asthma, chickenpox (caution).
interactions: Warfarin, ACE inhibitors, Aspirin.
alternatives: Paracetamol, alternating with ibuprofen for high fevers

name: Oral Rehydration Salts - ORS (أملاح الجفاف)
uses: Diarrhea-associated dehydration in children and adults. أملاح الجفاف للأطفال والكبار.
dosage: Children: 50-100mL/kg over 3-4 hours for mild dehydration. Adults: as needed.
side_effects: Hypernatremia (excess, especially low-osmolarity ORS is safer).
contraindications: Severe dehydration (IV needed), bowel obstruction, ileus.
interactions: None significant.

name: Naloxone (نالوكسون / نارقان)
uses: Opioid overdose reversal (emergency). عكس تأثير الأفيون في حالات الطوارئ.
dosage: IV/IM/SC: 0.4-2mg every 2-3 minutes (repeat until response). Intranasal: 4mg.
side_effects: Acute opioid withdrawal (agitation, tachycardia, hypertension, pulmonary edema), re-narcotization if opioid is long-acting.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity (rare).
interactions: Opioids (reverses effects - intended action).

name: Acetazolamide (أسيتازولاميد / دياموكس)
uses: Glaucoma, altitude sickness prevention, epilepsy (adjunct), metabolic alkalosis. ارتفاع ضغط العين والارتفاع الجبلي.
dosage: Glaucoma: 250mg 1-4 times daily. Altitude sickness: 125-250mg twice daily (start 24h before ascent).
side_effects: Diuresis, hypokalemia, metabolic acidosis, paresthesia (tingling hands/feet), kidney stones, sulfonamide allergy.
contraindications: Sulfonamide allergy, hyponatremia, hypokalemia, chronic non-congestive angle-closure glaucoma.
interactions: Salicylates, Lithium, Folic acid antagonists.
alternatives: Timolol (glaucoma), Ibuprofen (altitude - less effective), supplemental oxygen

name: Desmopressin (ديزموبريسين / DDAVP)
uses: Diabetes insipidus, nocturnal enuresis (bedwetting), von Willebrand disease, hemophilia A. سلس البول الليلي وداء السكري الكاذب.
dosage: Nasal: 10-40mcg/day. Oral: 0.1-0.4mg/day. IV: 0.3mcg/kg (bleeding disorders).
side_effects: Hyponatremia (dangerous - fluid restriction needed), headache, nausea, flushing.
contraindications: Heart failure, renal failure, polydipsia, hyponatremia, von Willebrand type IIB.
interactions: Indomethacin, Chlorpropamide (enhance effect), Lithium (reduce effect).

name: Methylprednisolone IV (ميثيل بريدنيزولون / سولوميدرول)
uses: MS exacerbations, severe asthma, anaphylaxis, spinal cord injury (early), transplant rejection. تفاقم التصلب المتعدد والصدمة التأقية.
dosage: 500mg-1g IV daily × 3-5 days (MS pulse). Severe asthma: 40-125mg IV every 6h.
side_effects: Hyperglycemia, insomnia, mood changes, hypertension, GI bleeding risk.
contraindications: Systemic fungal infection, live vaccines (high dose), active untreated serious infections.
interactions: NSAIDs (GI bleeding), Cyclosporine, Warfarin, Rifampicin.

name: Adenosine (أدينوسين / أدينوكارد)
uses: Acute SVT (supraventricular tachycardia) termination, diagnosis of wide complex tachycardias. علاج تسرع ضربات القلب الفوقبطيني.
dosage: 6mg rapid IV push (antecubital or above); if no response: 12mg after 1-2 min; repeat 12mg once.
side_effects: Transient: chest tightness, flushing, dyspnea, AV block (seconds), bronchospasm, headache.
contraindications: 2nd/3rd degree heart block, sinus node dysfunction, WPW (some variants), asthma (use cautiously).
interactions: Dipyridamole (potentiates - reduce dose to 3mg), Theophylline/Caffeine (antagonize - higher doses needed).

name: Norepinephrine / Noradrenaline (نورإبينفرين / نورادرينالين)
uses: Septic shock, cardiogenic shock, severe hypotension (ICU/emergency use). صدمة إنتانية وانخفاض الضغط الشديد.
dosage: 0.01-3 mcg/kg/min IV infusion (titrate to MAP ≥65 mmHg). Central line preferred.
side_effects: Hypertension, reflex bradycardia, arrhythmias, tissue necrosis (extravasation - use central line!), organ ischemia.
contraindications: Hypovolemia not corrected, mesenteric/peripheral vascular thrombosis, halothane anesthesia.
interactions: MAOIs (hypertensive crisis), TCAs, Halogenated anesthetics, Sympathomimetics.

name: Epinephrine / Adrenaline (أدرينالين / إبينفرين)
uses: Anaphylaxis (first-line), cardiac arrest, severe asthma, croup, local anesthetic adjunct. صدمة تأقية وسكتة قلبية.
