dosage: Anaphylaxis: 0.3-0.5mg IM (anterolateral thigh). Cardiac arrest: 1mg IV q3-5min. Auto-injector: 0.3mg IM (adults).
side_effects: Palpitations, hypertension, tremor, anxiety, headache, arrhythmias.
contraindications: No absolute contraindication in anaphylaxis or cardiac arrest.
interactions: MAOIs, TCAs, Beta-blockers (reduce effect), Digoxin, Halothane.
alternatives: Nothing for anaphylaxis (epinephrine is the ONLY first-line treatment)

name: Povidone Iodine (بيتادين)
uses: Wound cleaning, surgical site preparation, infected wounds, skin antisepsis. تطهير الجروح.
dosage: 10% solution: apply to affected area. 7.5% scrub for surgical prep.
side_effects: Skin irritation, iodine allergy (rare), thyroid absorption (large wounds/prolonged use).
contraindications: Iodine allergy, neonates (<1 month), thyroid disease (large wounds), pregnancy (avoid near term).
interactions: Hydrogen peroxide (inactivates each other - don't combine), Lithium.

name: Silver Sulfadiazine Cream (كريم سيلفر سلفاديازين / فلاميزين)
uses: Prevention and treatment of infection in burns. علاج وتطهير الحروق.
dosage: Apply 1/16 inch thick layer once or twice daily. Keep covered.
side_effects: Argyria (rare with extensive use), leukopenia (transient), sulfonamide allergy.
contraindications: Sulfonamide allergy, neonates (<2 months), near-term pregnancy, breastfeeding, G6PD deficiency (in neonates).
interactions: Enzymatic debriding agents (inactivated).
alternatives: Mafenide, Nanocrystalline silver dressings, Honey dressings

name: Digoxin (ديجوكسين / لانوكسين)
uses: Atrial fibrillation rate control, heart failure (HFrEF). الرجفان الأذيني وقصور القلب.
dosage: 0.125-0.25mg once daily (adjust by renal function and levels). Target serum level 0.5-0.9 ng/mL.
side_effects: Nausea, bradycardia, visual disturbances (yellow/green), arrhythmias (toxicity). سمية عالية عند جرعة زائدة.
contraindications: WPW syndrome, ventricular fibrillation, digoxin toxicity, hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia worsen toxicity.
interactions: Amiodarone, Verapamil, Quinidine (increase levels), Diuretics (hypokalemia increases toxicity).

name: Furosemide (فيوروسيميد / لاسيكس)
uses: Edema (heart failure, liver cirrhosis, renal disease), hypertension, hypercalcemia. وذمة قصور القلب والكبد.
dosage: Oral: 20-80mg daily or twice daily. IV: 20-40mg, double dose if no response after 1h. Max 600mg/day.
side_effects: Hypokalemia, hyponatremia, dehydration, ototoxicity (high IV doses), hyperuricemia. نقص البوتاسيوم.
contraindications: Anuria, sulfonamide allergy, hepatic coma, severe hyponatremia.
interactions: Aminoglycosides (ototoxicity), NSAIDs (reduce diuresis), Digoxin (hypokalemia), ACE inhibitors (hypotension).

name: Spironolactone (سبيرونولاكتون / ألداكتون)
uses: Heart failure (HFrEF), primary hyperaldosteronism, resistant hypertension, ascites, acne (off-label). قصور القلب وتشمع الكبد.
dosage: HF: 12.5-50mg once daily. Hyperaldosteronism: 100-400mg/day. Acne: 50-200mg/day.
side_effects: Hyperkalemia, gynecomastia (men), menstrual irregularities, renal impairment. ارتفاع البوتاسيوم والتثدي عند الرجال.
contraindications: Hyperkalemia (K+>5.5), severe renal failure, Addison's disease, concurrent use with eplerenone.
interactions: ACE inhibitors/ARBs (hyperkalemia risk), NSAIDs, Digoxin.

name: Bisoprolol (بيسوبرولول / كونكور)
uses: Heart failure (HFrEF), hypertension, angina, atrial fibrillation rate control. قصور القلب وضغط الدم.
dosage: HF: start 1.25mg daily, up to 10mg. HTN/Angina: 5-10mg once daily.
side_effects: Bradycardia, fatigue, cold extremities, hypotension, bronchospasm (rare — selective). تباطؤ النبض، تعب.
contraindications: Asthma (use cautiously), severe bradycardia, 2nd/3rd degree heart block, decompensated HF.
interactions: Verapamil/Diltiazem (bradycardia/AV block), Clonidine, Antidiabetics (mask hypoglycemia).

name: Carvedilol (كارفيديلول / كوريج)
uses: Heart failure (first-line), hypertension, post-MI. قصور القلب وضغط الدم.
dosage: HF: 3.125mg twice daily, up to 25-50mg twice daily. HTN: 12.5-25mg twice daily.
side_effects: Dizziness, fatigue, hypotension (especially first dose), weight gain, bradycardia.
contraindications: Decompensated HF, severe asthma, 2nd/3rd degree AV block, severe bradycardia.
interactions: Digoxin, Verapamil, Diltiazem, Amiodarone, Insulin.

name: Amiodarone (أميودارون / كورداروني)
uses: Ventricular arrhythmias, atrial fibrillation/flutter, SVT. اضطرابات النظم القلبية.
dosage: Loading: 200mg TID × 1 week, then 200mg BD × 1 week, then 200mg OD. IV: 5mg/kg over 20-60min.
side_effects: Thyroid dysfunction (hyper/hypo), pulmonary toxicity, corneal deposits, photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity, blue-gray skin. متعدد الأعضاء.
contraindications: Sinus bradycardia, AV block without pacemaker, iodine allergy (relative), pregnancy.
interactions: Warfarin (increase INR dramatically), Digoxin, Statins, many QT-prolonging drugs.

name: Isosorbide Mononitrate (أيزوسوربيد مونونيترات / إيزوكيت)
uses: Angina pectoris prevention, heart failure (with hydralazine). الذبحة الصدرية.
dosage: 20-60mg twice daily (with nitrate-free interval of 8-12h to prevent tolerance).
side_effects: Headache (very common initially), hypotension, dizziness, flushing.
contraindications: Severe hypotension, hypovolemia, concurrent PDE5 inhibitors (sildenafil — severe hypotension).
interactions: Sildenafil/Tadalafil (CONTRAINDICATED — severe hypotension), Antihypertensives.

name: Warfarin (وارفارين / كومادين)
uses: DVT/PE treatment and prevention, atrial fibrillation stroke prevention, mechanical heart valves. منع جلطات الدم.
dosage: Individualized based on INR target (2-3 for most, 2.5-3.5 for mechanical valves). Typical 2-10mg/day.
side_effects: Bleeding (main risk), skin necrosis (early), purple toe syndrome, teratogenicity.
contraindications: Pregnancy, active bleeding, severe hepatic disease, recent surgery (relative).
interactions: MANY interactions — key: Aspirin/NSAIDs (bleeding), Antibiotics (increase INR), Rifampicin (decrease INR), Amiodarone (increase INR dramatically).

name: Apixaban (أبيكسابان / إيليكيس)
category: Direct Oral Anticoagulant (DOAC) - Factor Xa inhibitor
uses: DVT/PE treatment/prevention, atrial fibrillation stroke prevention, post-orthopedic surgery. الجلطات والرجفان الأذيني.
dosage: AF: 5mg twice daily (2.5mg BD if ≥2 of: age≥80, weight≤60kg, creatinine≥1.5). DVT/PE: 10mg BD × 7d then 5mg BD.
side_effects: Bleeding, anemia, nausea. Lower bleeding risk than warfarin.
contraindications: Active bleeding, severe renal failure (eGFR<15), prosthetic heart valves.
interactions: P-gp inhibitors (increase levels), Rifampicin (decrease levels), other anticoagulants/antiplatelet.

name: Clopidogrel (كلوبيدوجريل / بلافيكس)
uses: ACS (NSTEMI/UA), PCI post-stent, stroke/TIA prevention, PAD. منع جلطات القلب والأوعية.
dosage: Loading: 300-600mg stat. Maintenance: 75mg once daily.
side_effects: Bleeding, GI upset, TTP (rare), rash.
contraindications: Active bleeding, severe hepatic disease, CYP2C19 poor metabolizers (reduced efficacy).
interactions: PPIs (especially Omeprazole — reduce efficacy via CYP2C19), NSAIDs, Warfarin.

name: Glibenclamide / Glyburide (جليبينكلاميد / داونيل)
uses: Type 2 diabetes. السكري من النوع الثاني.
dosage: 2.5-15mg daily (1-2 doses with meals). Start low in elderly.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (main risk — especially in elderly), weight gain, GI upset.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, DKA, renal failure (eGFR<30), elderly (high hypoglycemia risk), pregnancy.
interactions: NSAIDs (enhance hypoglycemia), Beta-blockers (mask signs), Fluconazole (enhance effect), Rifampicin (reduce).
alternatives: Gliclazide (safer in elderly), Glimepiride, Sitagliptin, Metformin

name: Gliclazide (جليكلازيد / ديامكرون)
uses: Type 2 diabetes. أكثر أماناً من جليبينكلاميد في كبار السن.
dosage: 40-320mg daily (with meals). MR formulation: 30-120mg once daily.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (less than glibenclamide), weight gain.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, DKA, severe renal/hepatic failure, sulfonamide allergy.
interactions: NSAIDs, Fluconazole, Beta-blockers, Rifampicin.

name: Sitagliptin (سيتاجليبتين / جانوفيا)
uses: Type 2 diabetes (mono or combo). سكري النوع الثاني.
dosage: 100mg once daily (50mg if eGFR 30-50, 25mg if eGFR<30).
side_effects: Nasopharyngitis, pancreatitis (rare), joint pain, urinary infection.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, DKA.
interactions: Insulin/sulfonylureas (hypoglycemia risk when combined).

name: Empagliflozin (إمباجليفلوزين / جارديانس)
uses: Type 2 diabetes + CV protection, heart failure, CKD. سكري مع حماية القلب والكلى.
dosage: 10mg once daily (can increase to 25mg for glucose control). HF: 10mg once daily.
side_effects: Genital mycotic infections, UTI, DKA (rare — even with normal glucose in T2DM), euglycemic DKA, dehydration, amputation risk.
contraindications: Type 1 DM, eGFR<20 (for glucose), severe renal failure.
interactions: Diuretics (dehydration), Insulin (hypoglycemia), lithium.

name: Liraglutide (ليراجلوتيد / فيكتوزا)
uses: Type 2 diabetes + weight loss + CV risk reduction. سكري مع تقليل الوزن والوقاية القلبية.
dosage: 0.6mg SC daily for 1 week, then 1.2mg, max 1.8mg daily.
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, pancreatitis (rare), thyroid C-cell tumors (animal data).
contraindications: Personal/family history of medullary thyroid cancer, MEN2, pancreatitis.
interactions: Insulin (hypoglycemia), oral medications (delayed absorption).

name: Insulin Glargine (إنسولين جلارجين / لانتوس)
uses: Type 1 and 2 diabetes — basal insulin control. الإنسولين الأساسي للسكري.
dosage: SC once daily (same time). Start 10 units or 0.2 units/kg, titrate by 2 units every 3 days to FBG target.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia (main risk), injection site reactions, weight gain.
contraindications: Hypoglycemia episodes, never give IV.
interactions: Antidiabetics (additive hypoglycemia), Beta-blockers (mask signs), Corticosteroids (increase glucose).
alternatives: Insulin detemir, Insulin degludec, NPH insulin

name: Insulin Aspart (إنسولين أسبارت / نوفورابيد)
uses: Mealtime glucose control in T1DM and T2DM. الإنسولين السريع للوجبات.
dosage: SC 0-15 minutes before meals. Dose individualized per meal carb content. Can also use IV in ICU.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia, injection site reactions, weight gain.
contraindications: Hypoglycemia. Never mix with other insulins in same syringe (except NPH).
interactions: See insulin glargine interactions.
alternatives: Insulin lispro, Insulin glulisine, Regular insulin

name: Pioglitazone (بيوجليتازون / أكتوس)
uses: Type 2 diabetes, NASH (off-label). سكري النوع الثاني.
dosage: 15-45mg once daily (with or without food).
side_effects: Weight gain, fluid retention, heart failure exacerbation, bladder cancer (long-term risk), bone fractures.
contraindications: Heart failure, active bladder cancer, severe hepatic impairment.
interactions: CYP2C8 inhibitors (gemfibrozil — increase levels), insulin (additive effects).

name: Rosuvastatin (روسوفاستاتين / كريستور)
uses: Hyperlipidemia, cardiovascular risk reduction, primary/secondary prevention. تقليل الكوليسترول والوقاية القلبية.
dosage: 5-40mg once daily (evening). Max 20mg in Asian patients or with certain interactions.
side_effects: Myalgia, myopathy, rhabdomyolysis (rare), elevated liver enzymes, diabetes risk (slight).
contraindications: Active liver disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, CK elevation.
interactions: Gemfibrozil (rhabdomyolysis risk), Cyclosporine, Antacids (reduce absorption), Warfarin.

name: Atorvastatin (أتورفاستاتين / ليبيتور)
uses: Hyperlipidemia, CV risk reduction, post-ACS. الكوليسترول وأمراض القلب.
dosage: 10-80mg once daily (any time). Post-ACS: high-intensity (40-80mg).
side_effects: Myalgia, transaminase elevation, rhabdomyolysis (rare), cognitive effects (rare).
contraindications: Active liver disease, pregnancy, CK>10× normal.
interactions: CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin, azole antifungals), Gemfibrozil, Digoxin, Warfarin.

name: Ezetimibe (إيزيتيميب / زيتيا)
uses: Hypercholesterolemia (mono or add-on to statin). الكوليسترول المرتفع.
dosage: 10mg once daily (can be taken at any time).
side_effects: Myopathy (when combined with statin), diarrhea, abdominal pain, elevated liver enzymes.
contraindications: Active liver disease. Monotherapy in pregnancy (Category C).
interactions: Statins (myopathy risk, but generally well-tolerated), Bile acid sequestrants (separate by 2h), Cyclosporine.
alternatives: Statins, Bile acid sequestrants, PCSK9 inhibitors

name: Fenofibrate (فينوفيبرات / تريكور)
uses: Hypertriglyceridemia, mixed hyperlipidemia. ارتفاع الدهون الثلاثية.
dosage: 145mg once daily (with meals). Reduce dose with renal impairment.
side_effects: Myopathy (especially with statins), elevated creatinine, GI upset, gallstones, elevated transaminases.
contraindications: Renal failure (eGFR<30), hepatic disease, gallbladder disease.
interactions: Statins (myopathy — avoid gemfibrozil with statins, fenofibrate safer), Warfarin (enhance anticoagulation).

name: Pantoprazole (بانتوبرازول / بانتوباك)
uses: GERD, peptic ulcer, stress ulcer prophylaxis in ICU, Zollinger-Ellison. حموضة المعدة والقرحة.
dosage: 20-40mg once daily before breakfast. IV: 40mg daily or twice daily.
side_effects: Headache, diarrhea, B12/magnesium deficiency (long-term), C. diff risk, hypomagnesemia.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Caution with long-term use.
interactions: Methotrexate (increase levels), Atazanavir (avoid), Clopidogrel (less interaction than Omeprazole).

name: Domperidone (دومبيريدون / موتيليوم)
uses: Nausea, vomiting, gastroparesis, gastroesophageal reflux. الغثيان والتقيؤ وتأخر إفراغ المعدة.
dosage: 10mg 3 times daily before meals (max 30mg/day). Use lowest effective dose.
side_effects: QT prolongation (risk at high doses/IV), galactorrhea, prolactin elevation.
contraindications: Prolactin-secreting tumor, concurrent QT-prolonging drugs, hepatic impairment.
interactions: Ketoconazole, Erythromycin (increase levels/QT risk), Anticholinergics (oppose effect).
alternatives: Metoclopramide, Ondansetron, Erythromycin (low dose for gastroparesis)

name: Lactulose (لاكتيولوز / دوبالاك)
uses: Constipation, hepatic encephalopathy (reduces ammonia). الإمساك وتساعد في أمراض الكبد.
dosage: Constipation: 15-30mL once or twice daily. Hepatic encephalopathy: 30-45mL 3-4 times daily (target 2-3 soft stools/day).
side_effects: Bloating, flatulence, diarrhea (excessive use), abdominal cramps, electrolyte imbalance.
contraindications: Galactosemia, lactose/galactose-free diet. Caution in diabetes (contains sugars).
interactions: Antibiotics (may reduce efficacy in HE), Antacids.

name: Mesalazine / Mesalamine (ميسالازين / بنتاسا)
uses: Ulcerative colitis (induction and maintenance), Crohn's disease (limited). التهاب القولون التقرحي.
dosage: Oral: 2-4g/day in divided doses. Rectal: 1g suppository at night. Enema: 1g/100mL.
side_effects: Nausea, headache, nephrotoxicity (rare), hair loss, hypersensitivity, pericarditis (rare).
contraindications: Severe renal/hepatic impairment, salicylate allergy.
interactions: Azathioprine/6-mercaptopurine (increase myelotoxicity), Warfarin, NSAIDs.

name: Hyoscine Butylbromide (هيوسين / بوسكوبان)
uses: GI spasms, renal/biliary colic, IBS, dysmenorrhea. تقلصات المعدة والأمعاء والكلى.
dosage: Oral: 10-20mg 3-4 times daily. IV/IM: 20mg up to 100mg/day.
side_effects: Dry mouth, blurred vision, urinary retention, tachycardia, constipation. جفاف الفم.
contraindications: Glaucoma, myasthenia gravis, benign prostatic hyperplasia, megacolon, tachyarrhythmias.
interactions: Tricyclic antidepressants, Antihistamines (additive anticholinergic effects).

name: Budesonide Inhaler (بوديزونيد / بوليكورت)
uses: Asthma prevention, COPD (combined therapy), allergic rhinitis (nasal spray). الوقاية من الربو.
dosage: Asthma: 200-800mcg twice daily (via inhaler). COPD: 200-400mcg twice daily. Croup: 2mg nebulized single dose.
side_effects: Oral candidiasis (rinse mouth after use), hoarseness, adrenal suppression (high doses), growth retardation in children.
contraindications: Acute severe asthma (use IV steroids). Not for relief of acute bronchospasm.
interactions: CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole — increase levels).

name: Tiotropium (تيوتروبيوم / اسبيريفا)
uses: COPD maintenance, asthma (add-on). علاج COPD المزمن.
dosage: 18mcg once daily via HandiHaler, or 2.5mcg via Respimat once daily.
side_effects: Dry mouth (most common), constipation, urinary retention, glaucoma worsening, tachycardia.
contraindications: Narrow-angle glaucoma, urinary retention, known hypersensitivity.
interactions: Other anticholinergics (additive effects).

name: Formoterol (فورموتيرول / فورادايل)
uses: Asthma maintenance (with ICS), COPD maintenance, prevention of exercise-induced bronchospasm. الربو والـ COPD.
dosage: 12mcg twice daily via inhaler. Max 48mcg/day.
side_effects: Tremor, palpitations, tachycardia, hypokalemia (high doses). رعشة وسرعة النبض.
contraindications: Monotherapy in asthma without ICS (black box warning), tachyarrhythmias.
interactions: Beta-blockers (oppose), MAOIs, Tricyclics (cardiovascular), QT-prolonging drugs.

name: N-Acetylcysteine - NAC (ن-أستيل سيستئين / فلوموكيل)
uses: Productive cough/mucus thickening, paracetamol overdose antidote, contrast nephropathy prevention. مُرقق البلغم وترياق التسمم بالباراسيتامول.
dosage: Mucolytic: 200mg TID or 600mg once daily. Paracetamol OD: 150mg/kg IV over 60min, then 50mg/kg over 4h, then 100mg/kg over 16h.
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting (oral), anaphylactoid reaction (IV - rate-dependent), bronchospasm (nebulized).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Caution in asthma (nebulized can cause bronchospasm).
interactions: Nitroglycerin (enhance vasodilation), Activated charcoal (reduce absorption if given orally).

name: Levetiracetam (ليفيتيراسيتام / كيبرا)
uses: Focal seizures, generalized tonic-clonic, myoclonic seizures, adjunct or mono. نوبات الصرع.
dosage: Start 250-500mg twice daily, increase by 500mg every 2-4 weeks. Max 3000mg/day (mild renal adjustment).
side_effects: Irritability, behavioral changes, depression, somnolence, dizziness. تغيرات في السلوك.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Caution in renal impairment (reduce dose).
interactions: Few significant drug interactions (major advantage).

name: Valproate / Valproic Acid (فالبروات / ديباكين)
uses: Epilepsy (generalized, focal), bipolar disorder, migraine prophylaxis. الصرع والثنائي القطب.
dosage: 15-30mg/kg/day in 2-3 divided doses. Target level 50-100 mcg/mL.
side_effects: Weight gain, tremor, hair loss, hepatotoxicity (children <2y especially), teratogenicity (neural tube defects), PCOS.
contraindications: Pregnancy (Category X), mitochondrial disease, urea cycle disorders, hepatic disease, pancreatitis.
interactions: Carbamazepine (reduce levels), Lamotrigine (increase lamotrigine levels), Aspirin (toxicity).
alternatives: Lamotrigine (safer in women of childbearing age), Levetiracetam, Lithium (bipolar)

name: Carbamazepine (كارباماريبين / تيجريتول)
uses: Focal/partial seizures, trigeminal neuralgia, bipolar disorder (2nd line). الصرع وآلام الأعصاب.
dosage: Start 100-200mg twice daily, increase by 200mg every week. Usual: 400-1600mg/day in divided doses.
side_effects: Diplopia, ataxia, hyponatremia (SIADH), Stevens-Johnson syndrome (HLA-B*1502 — Asian), aplastic anemia, teratogenicity.
contraindications: Bone marrow suppression, MAOIs, porphyria, HLA-B*1502 positive (SJS risk).
interactions: CYP3A4 inducer (reduces many drugs: OCP, warfarin, statins), MAOIs (fatal), many interactions.

name: Quetiapine (كيتيابين / سيروكيل)
uses: Schizophrenia, bipolar disorder (mania and depression), adjunctive depression, insomnia (off-label, low dose). الفصام والثنائي القطب.
dosage: Schizophrenia: 150-750mg/day in 2-3 doses. Bipolar: 200-800mg/day. Insomnia: 12.5-50mg HS.
side_effects: Sedation (first dose effect), weight gain, dyslipidemia, hyperglycemia, orthostatic hypotension, QT prolongation, tardive dyskinesia (rare).
contraindications: QT prolongation, concurrent QT-prolonging drugs. Elderly with dementia (increased mortality).
interactions: CNS depressants (sedation), CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers, QT-prolonging drugs.

name: Sertraline (سيرترالين / زولوفت)
uses: Depression, OCD, panic disorder, PTSD, social anxiety, PMDD. الاكتئاب وقلق.
dosage: Start 25-50mg once daily, increase by 25-50mg every 1-2 weeks. Usual: 50-200mg/day.
side_effects: Nausea (especially initially), sexual dysfunction, insomnia/somnolence, diarrhea, headache, serotonin syndrome (rare — with MAOIs).
contraindications: MAOIs (within 14 days), pimozide, severe hepatic failure.
interactions: MAOIs (serotonin syndrome - FATAL), Tramadol (seizures/SS), Warfarin (increase bleeding), Triptans.
pregnancy_safety: Category C (neonatal withdrawal if used late pregnancy)

name: Clonazepam (كلونازيبام / ريفوتريل)
uses: Absence seizures, myoclonic seizures, panic disorder, anxiety. الصرع وقلق ذعر.
dosage: Epilepsy: 0.5-20mg/day in divided doses. Panic: 0.25-2mg twice daily.
side_effects: Sedation, tolerance, dependence, withdrawal (seizures), cognitive impairment, ataxia.
contraindications: Severe respiratory insufficiency, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma, severe hepatic disease.
interactions: CNS depressants (enhanced sedation), Alcohol, CYP3A4 inhibitors.

name: Pregabalin (بريجابالين / ليريكا)
uses: Neuropathic pain (diabetic, postherpetic), fibromyalgia, partial seizures, generalized anxiety. آلام الأعصاب والقلق.
dosage: Neuropathy: 75-150mg twice daily. Max 600mg/day. Renal dose adjustment required.
side_effects: Dizziness, somnolence, weight gain, peripheral edema, blurred vision, dependence.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. Caution in heart failure (edema), suicidal ideation.
interactions: CNS depressants (sedation), Opioids (respiratory depression), Lorazepam (acute respiratory failure).

name: Tramadol (ترامادول / ترامال)
uses: Moderate to moderately severe pain, neuropathic pain, cancer pain (2nd line). آلام متوسطة إلى شديدة.
dosage: 50-100mg every 4-6 hours. Max 400mg/day (300mg in elderly). Extended-release: 100-300mg once daily.
side_effects: Nausea, dizziness, seizures (overdose or with SSRIs), serotonin syndrome (with SSRIs/MAOIs), dependence, respiratory depression (high dose).
contraindications: MAOIs (within 14 days), epilepsy (lowers seizure threshold), severe respiratory insufficiency, SSRIs/SNRIs caution.
interactions: MAOIs (serotonin syndrome), SSRIs/SNRIs (serotonin syndrome + seizures), CNS depressants, Carbamazepine (reduce levels).
alternatives: Codeine, Oxycodone, NSAIDs + Paracetamol combination, Morphine

name: Colchicine (كولشيسين / كولكيز)
uses: Acute gout attack, gout prevention, familial Mediterranean fever, pericarditis. نوبات النقرس.
dosage: Acute gout: 1mg stat, then 0.5mg after 1h (max 1.5mg per episode). Prophylaxis: 0.5-1mg once daily.
side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting (dose-dependent), myopathy, neuropathy (long-term), bone marrow suppression (rare).
contraindications: Severe renal or hepatic impairment. Caution with P-gp and CYP3A4 inhibitors.
interactions: CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, cyclosporine — reduce dose dramatically!), P-gp inhibitors, Statins (myopathy).

name: Allopurinol (ألوبيورينول / زيلوريك)
uses: Chronic gout prevention, uric acid nephropathy, tumor lysis syndrome prevention. الوقاية من النقرس.
dosage: 100-800mg once daily. Start low (100mg), titrate to target uric acid <6mg/dL. Renal dose adjustment.
side_effects: Rash (can progress to Stevens-Johnson), hypersensitivity syndrome (especially HLA-B*5801 in Asian patients), hepatotoxicity, GI upset.
contraindications: Acute gout attack (don't start/stop allopurinol during acute flare). HLA-B*5801 positive (SJS risk).
interactions: Azathioprine/6-MP (CONTRAINDICATED — fatal — reduce dose to 25%), Warfarin (increase levels), Ampicillin (rash).

name: Hydroxychloroquine (هيدروكسي كلوروكين / بلاكينيل)
uses: Rheumatoid arthritis, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), malaria prevention. الروماتويد والذئبة الحمراء.
dosage: RA/SLE: 200-400mg once daily (max 5mg/kg/day based on ideal body weight). Malaria prophylaxis: 400mg weekly.
side_effects: Retinopathy (dose/duration-dependent — requires annual ophthalmology monitoring), GI upset, QT prolongation, rash, cardiomyopathy.
contraindications: Pre-existing retinopathy, long QT syndrome, G6PD deficiency (malaria use).
interactions: QT-prolonging drugs, Antacids (reduce absorption), Methotrexate, Digoxin.
pregnancy_safety: Category C — generally considered safe in pregnancy for autoimmune disease

name: Methotrexate (ميتوتريكسيت / ريوماتريكس)
uses: Rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, certain cancers. الروماتويد، الصدفية، والأورام.
dosage: RA: 7.5-25mg once weekly (+ folic acid 5mg next day to reduce toxicity). Cancer: varies widely.
side_effects: Mucositis, nausea, hepatotoxicity (fibrosis/cirrhosis long-term), myelosuppression, pulmonary toxicity, teratogenicity.
contraindications: Pregnancy (teratogenic — Category X), breastfeeding, significant renal/hepatic impairment, alcohol use, immunodeficiency.
interactions: NSAIDs (increase toxicity), Trimethoprim (folate antagonism — avoid), Probenecid (increase levels), Amoxicillin.

name: Levothyroxine - T4 (ليفوثيروكسين / إيروكسين)
uses: Hypothyroidism (all types), thyroid cancer post-thyroidectomy, goiter. قصور الدرقية.
dosage: Average: 1.6mcg/kg/day once daily (fasting, 30-60 min before breakfast). Start low in elderly/cardiac disease (25mcg).
side_effects: Symptoms of hyperthyroidism if overdosed: tachycardia, weight loss, anxiety, heat intolerance, bone loss (long-term excess).
contraindications: Thyrotoxicosis, untreated adrenal insufficiency.
interactions: Calcium/iron supplements (take 4h apart — reduce absorption), Antacids, Cholestyramine, Amiodarone.
pregnancy_safety: Category A — Safe and often requires dose increase in pregnancy

name: Carbimazole (كارباميزول / نيومركازول)
uses: Hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease, toxic nodular goiter), pre-surgical preparation. فرط الدرقية.
dosage: Initially 15-40mg/day in divided doses. Maintenance 5-15mg/day once daily.
side_effects: Agranulocytosis (rare but serious — stop drug and check WBC if fever/sore throat), rash, hepatotoxicity, hypothyroidism.
contraindications: Agranulocytosis history. Avoid in breastfeeding (propylthiouracil preferred).
interactions: Warfarin (increase anticoagulation), Digoxin levels change with thyroid status.

name: Tamsulosin (تامسيولوزين / فلوماكس)
uses: Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), ureteral stones (facilitates passage). تضخم البروستاتا.
dosage: 0.4mg once daily (after first meal). Max 0.8mg/day.
side_effects: Retrograde ejaculation, dizziness, orthostatic hypotension, floppy iris syndrome (IFIS — warn ophthalmologist before surgery), asthenia.
contraindications: Orthostatic hypotension, concurrent PDE5 inhibitors (hypotension risk), hypersensitivity.
interactions: PDE5 inhibitors (sildenafil — hypotension), Cimetidine (increase levels), Other alpha-blockers.

name: Finasteride (فينيستيريد / بروسكار / بروبيشيا)
uses: BPH (5mg), male pattern baldness (1mg). تضخم البروستاتا والصلع.
dosage: BPH: 5mg once daily. Androgenetic alopecia: 1mg once daily. Effect seen after 3-6 months.
side_effects: Sexual dysfunction (decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, ejaculation disorder), gynecomastia, depression (rare), prostate cancer risk reduction (may mask PSA).
contraindications: Women (especially pregnant — teratogenic, Category X), children.
interactions: None clinically significant.

name: Sildenafil (سيلدينافيل / فياجرا / ريفاتيو)
uses: Erectile dysfunction, pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). ضعف الانتصاب وارتفاع ضغط الشريان الرئوي.
dosage: ED: 25-100mg taken 30-60 minutes before sexual activity. PAH: 20mg 3 times daily.
side_effects: Headache, flushing, visual disturbances (blue tinge — reversible), nasal congestion, hypotension, priapism (rare).
contraindications: Concurrent nitrates or nitric oxide donors (ABSOLUTE — severe hypotension/death), severe hepatic impairment, recent stroke/MI.
interactions: Nitrates (CONTRAINDICATED), Alpha-blockers (hypotension), CYP3A4 inhibitors (increase levels dramatically).
pregnancy_safety: Category B (PAH use), Category X for ED in women

name: Tretinoin (تريتينوين / ريتين-أيه)
uses: Acne vulgaris, photoaging, fine wrinkles, hyperpigmentation. حب الشباب وتجديد الجلد.
dosage: Apply thin layer to affected area at bedtime. Start with 0.025%, increase to 0.05%, then 0.1% as tolerated. Apply only at night.
side_effects: Dryness, peeling, erythema, photosensitivity (ALWAYS use SPF), initial acne flare ('purging').
contraindications: Pregnancy (Category C/D — avoid), eczema, rosacea.
interactions: Benzoyl peroxide (inactivates each other — use at different times), Salicylic acid products, Waxing.
pregnancy_safety: Category C — avoid in pregnancy (teratogenic concerns)

name: Betamethasone Cream (بيتاميثازون / بيتنوفيت)
uses: Psoriasis, eczema, contact dermatitis, lichen planus, other steroid-responsive skin conditions. الصدفية والأكزيما.
dosage: Apply thin layer once or twice daily to affected area. Avoid prolonged use, especially on face/flexures/genitalia.
side_effects: Skin atrophy, telangiectasia, striae, acne, folliculitis, systemic absorption (large areas), HPA axis suppression, perioral dermatitis.
contraindications: Rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, fungal/viral/bacterial skin infections, pruritus without inflammation.
interactions: Systemic corticosteroids (additive adrenal suppression with large area topical use).
pregnancy_safety: Category C — avoid prolonged use in pregnancy

name: Latanoprost (لاتانوبروست / إكساليف)
uses: Open-angle glaucoma, ocular hypertension. الجلوكوما (المياه الزرقاء).
dosage: One drop in affected eye(s) once daily in the evening.
side_effects: Iris color change (irreversible — increased brown pigmentation), eyelash growth/darkening, periorbital pigmentation, hyperemia, blurred vision.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, intraocular inflammation.
interactions: Thimerosal-containing eye drops (precipitate — use different eye drops with 5-minute interval), Bimatoprost (may have opposing effects).

name: Timolol Eye Drops (تيمولول قطرة)
uses: Open-angle glaucoma, ocular hypertension. ضغط العين.
dosage: 0.25% or 0.5%: one drop in affected eye(s) twice daily (or once daily — long-acting formulation).
side_effects: Local: mild stinging. Systemic (absorbed): bradycardia, bronchospasm, hypotension, fatigue, depression.
contraindications: Asthma, COPD, bradycardia, 2nd/3rd degree heart block, heart failure.
interactions: Systemic beta-blockers (additive), Calcium channel blockers, Quinidine.

name: Folic Acid (حمض الفوليك / فوليفيتال)
uses: Prevention of neural tube defects (pregnancy), megaloblastic anemia, methotrexate supplementation, sickle cell disease. الوقاية من عيوب القناة العصبية.
dosage: Pre-conception/pregnancy: 400mcg-5mg once daily. Methotrexate supplementation: 5mg once weekly (day after MTX). Anemia: 5mg once daily.
side_effects: Generally very well tolerated. High doses may mask B12 deficiency (subacute combined degeneration).
contraindications: Use cautiously if undiagnosed macrocytic anemia (rule out B12 deficiency first).
interactions: Methotrexate (folic acid reduces toxicity but may slightly reduce efficacy), Phenytoin/Carbamazepine (may reduce folate levels).
alternatives: Folinic acid (leucovorin) — active form, used with MTX rescue

name: Vitamin B12 / Cyanocobalamin (فيتامين ب12 / سيانوكوبالامين)
uses: B12 deficiency anemia (pernicious anemia, vegans, metformin users, elderly), neuropathy. نقص ب12 وفقر الدم.
dosage: IM: 1mg daily × 5-7 days, then weekly × 4 weeks, then monthly. Oral (sublingual preferred): 1000-2000mcg daily (high oral dose compensates for poor absorption).
side_effects: Generally very safe. Rare: allergic reaction to IM injection, acne-like rash.
contraindications: Leber's optic neuropathy (pure cyanocobalamin contraindicated — use hydroxocobalamin).
interactions: PPIs, H2 blockers, Metformin (reduce absorption — may need supplementation).
alternatives: Hydroxocobalamin (preferred IM form — lasts longer), Methylcobalamin
pregnancy_safety: Category A — Essential in pregnancy (Category C at megadoses)

name: Calcium + Vitamin D3 (كالسيوم + فيتامين د / كالسيتريول)
uses: Osteoporosis prevention/treatment, rickets, osteomalacia, hypoparathyroidism, pregnancy, elderly. هشاشة العظام.
dosage: Calcium: 500-1000mg/day (split doses — max 500mg elemental per dose for absorption). Vitamin D3: 800-2000 IU/day; deficiency: 50,000 IU weekly × 8-12 weeks.
side_effects: Constipation, hypercalcemia (overdose), hypercalciuria, kidney stones (calcium excess), nausea.
contraindications: Hypercalcemia, hyperparathyroidism, sarcoidosis, certain tumors. Calcium contraindicated with tetracyclines/quinolones (chelation — take 2h apart).
interactions: Thyroid hormones, Bisphosphonates, Iron, Tetracyclines, Fluoroquinolones — all require 2-4h separation. Thiazides increase hypercalcemia risk.
alternatives: Alfacalcidol (active D3), Calcitriol (active D3), Bisphosphonates (for established osteoporosis)

name: Ferric Carboxymaltose (حديد وريدي / فيراينجيكت)
uses: Iron deficiency anemia (when oral iron not tolerated/insufficient), IDA in IBD, CKD, post-partum. فقر الدم بنقص الحديد.
dosage: Calculated by Ganzoni formula or per SmPC. Typical: 500-1000mg IV infusion, can repeat.
side_effects: Hypophosphatemia (ferric carboxymaltose specific), hypersensitivity reactions, nausea, arthralgia, flushing.
contraindications: Non-IDA anemia, hemochromatosis, hypersensitivity to IV iron, first trimester pregnancy.
interactions: Oral iron (reduce absorption if given simultaneously), ACE inhibitors (hypersensitivity risk).
alternatives: Ferrous sulfate (oral), Iron sucrose IV, Ferric gluconate IV, Blood transfusion

name: Zinc Sulfate (كبريتات الزنك / زينكوفال)
uses: Zinc deficiency, diarrhea in children (WHO protocol), wound healing, acne, COVID-19 adjunct (debated). نقص الزنك والإسهال عند الأطفال.
dosage: Deficiency: 25-50mg elemental zinc daily. Children diarrhea: 10mg/day (<6 months), 20mg/day (>6 months) × 10-14 days.
side_effects: Nausea, GI upset (take with food), copper deficiency (long-term high dose), metallic taste.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity. High doses reduce copper absorption.
interactions: Tetracyclines, Fluoroquinolones (chelation — separate by 2h), Iron supplements.
alternatives: Zinc gluconate, Zinc oxide (topical for acne), Zinc acetate (Wilson's disease)
pregnancy_safety: Category A (at RDA), Category C (high doses)
